On September 30, the window closes for my first fundraising report of the general election.
This week, Donald Trump recorded a video in the Oval Office attacking me by name. The President of the United States does not spend his time on safe seats.
**So let me tell you how that affects the Sept. 30 deadline:****It is not just a scoreboard now. It is the document that party committees, national reporters, and every outside group with a checkbook will read to decide whether we have a chance in November. A strong number puts us on the map. A weak one tells them the GOP incumbent can hold this seat.**
**The money is already lopsided.** At the end of June, my opponent had nearly $1 million in the bank – about 13 times what I had.
He has taken over $365,000 from corporate PACs. I do not take a dime of corporate PAC money.

name: Gina Hinojosa
subject: I am personally asking you to believe, Peter
body:
We have the support, Peter. Now I need your faith.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Peter,
In just a minute, I’m going to personally ask you to **[make a $5 donation to my campaign for governor.](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260925_5_leap.16nccj&refcode=em20260925-2245&amount=5&t=1&akid=2245%2E299639%2EBKWDoL)**
Before I do, I want to share numbers from a brand-new poll, and what they tell me about faith.
This week, Marist released a new poll of Texas voters. Here are the first two numbers:
**🔵 Gina Hinojosa 49%
🔴 Greg Abbott 46%**
But it also shows another number: **28%.**
That’s the percentage of Texas voters, regardless of who they’re supporting, who think I will win this race. 68% think Greg Abbott will win, even though more voters in this poll said they're with me than with him. And more than a third of Democrats said they expect Abbott to come out on top.
**We have the support to win this race on November 3. What we don’t have yet is the belief.**
That gap is exactly what Greg Abbott is counting on. He doesn't need Texans to like him. _He needs us to believe he can't be beaten, because people who don't believe they can win don't chip in, don't knock doors, and don't show up._
I've seen this before. Back in 2021, the Texas GOP was ramming an extreme anti-voter bill through the State House. Everyone assumed it was a done deal. They had the votes, and we were supposed to sit there and take it.
So I took a leap of faith. I chose to walk off the floor. But I couldn't stop that bill on my own, so I stood up and texted my fellow Democratic legislators:
_“A leap of faith only works if you take it.”_
They took it with me. Together, we broke quorum, ran out the clock, and stopped a bill designed to silence Texas voters. We protected Sunday morning voting, a sacred tradition in Black churches, and blocked a provision that would have let partisan judges overturn election results without evidence.
**Nobody thought we could do it. We did it anyway, because enough of us believed at the same time.**
That's what this moment calls for. The numbers say this race is within reach. Now it's up to us to believe it, and act like it, so we can finally beat corrupt Governor Greg Abbott and take Texas back.
Each time you chip in to our people-powered campaign, you're doing it alongside hundreds of thousands of others who have decided to believe in what we can win together.
**[Can I count on you to take this leap of faith with me today?](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260925_5_leap.16nccj&refcode=em20260925-2245&amount=5&t=2&akid=2245%2E299639%2EBKWDoL)**
[Donate $5 »](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260925_5_leap.16nccj&amount=5&refcode=em20260925-2245&t=21&akid=2245%2E299639%2EBKWDoL)
_A leap of faith only works if you take it._ And when you do, others will leap with you.
— Gina

[ Donate » ](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_gh_footer?refcode=em20260925-5&t=22&refcode2=2245_299639_BKWDoL&akid=2245%2E299639%2EBKWDoL)

__The Democrats are at war with the American people -- open borders, defunding ICE, eliminating voter ID, putting men in women's sports.__

You name it, they are on the wrong side of it.

body:
We’re in the home stretch of the election.
# [](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/126?t=1&akid=9139%2E582294%2EcpOcNM)
Hi, it’s Chris.
**_Can I get a few moments to reintroduce myself —[and explain why I’m asking for your $5 donation today?](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260925_4.tII6I8&refcode=em20260925-4&t=2&akid=9139%2E582294%2EcpOcNM)_**
Over 100 years ago, my great-grandfather came here from Greece and opened our family restaurant that became a beloved local spot. That’s where I learned how to work hard and show up for my community – lessons I carried with me into the State House, Congress, and now my run for Senate.
I’m running against John Sununu, the son of a political dynasty family with deep pockets. He said he’d like to “send me back to bussing tables,” as if that’s an insult.
John Sununu doesn’t know a thing about hard work.
I’m proud to be running this race the right way – no corporate PACs, just a grassroots team built by people like you, chipping in what they can, when they can.
But with just 39 days until the election, recent polls show Sununu is surging into the lead, **and this race has officially shifted to a Toss Up.**
I know what it takes to win in a swing state like New Hampshire – and we can’t flip the Senate if we don’t win this open seat.
**[That’s why I need you to stand with me today. Please chip in $5 to help my campaign win this seat and give Democrats a shot at taking back the Senate.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260925_4.tII6I8&refcode=em20260925-4&t=3&akid=9139%2E582294%2EcpOcNM)**

Chris

name: Abdul El-Sayed
subject: What Bernie told me about lying
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Abdul for U
body:
Peter, early in my career, Bernie Sanders gave me a piece of advice I’ve never forgotten.
He said, _“In politics, people succeed either by being really good at lying or really good at telling the truth.__**You strike me as someone who’s not good at lying — so your job is to get really good at telling the truth.**__”_
So today, I’m going to tell you some truths about this campaign.
1. **This race is as competitive as it gets.** A recent poll has us _trailing_ Mike Rogers by 1.4 points. I’d be lying if I said I felt comfortable where we’re at right now.

2. **September 30 is our biggest fundraising hurdle yet, the FEC end-of-quarter deadline.** This is a make-or-break moment for us. We have to raise as much as we can to compete with the $70 million benefiting Mike Rogers.

3. **I can’t do any of this without you and other members of this grassroots team.** Your support is the only reason we beat a historic level of spending in the primary election, and I know it’s the only way we’ll defeat MAGA Republicans in November.

Finally, one more piece of truth: I don’t love asking people for money.
But because this is a 100% people-powered campaign, I’m relying on folks like you who care about the future of our country to pitch in. If you can contribute today, it’d be a huge help:
[_**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-ms-aes-20260925-5-ak**_](https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20260925-5-ak.zINJWn&amount=5&refcode=em20260925-3295&t=2&akid=3316%2E251025%2EsVMUks)

Our neck-and-neck race is putting Kansas on the map, and I’ve never felt more convinced we can win. But to win, we need to raise every last dollar we can to reach every Kansan.

I can only do that with your help, and that’s why I’m humbly asking you to **_[chip in a few bucks today](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/139982907/649179628/417919962?amounts=10,25,50,100,250&refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk617&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjMvMS8xMjYxMjYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiODI0N2FlNWItNGZiOS1mMTExLWE2YTktMDAwZDNhNTZkMmY3IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=qg6l_8bcjUydml0zmPc3G3S6ZH5qs-6FRK-_yIK4EvI=)_** if you can. # New Mexico voters aren't a sideshow
---
| | | | | | Friend,
Deb Haaland has turned down a debate with every major news outlet in New Mexico.
KRQE offered a debate. KOAT offered a debate. KVIA offered a debate. The Albuquerque Journal and the Santa Fe New Mexican each offered a debate. I said yes to every single one. She said no to every single one.
This week, she walked away from KOB too, the one debate her own campaign had agreed to. Her campaign's explanation? They said they want to "move past this sideshow."
Think about that. A debate is the one night when both candidates stand on the same stage, with no script and no handlers, and answer directly to the people of New Mexico. That is what Deb Haaland's campaign is calling a sideshow.
This mess was of her campaign's own making. I agreed to the KOB debate on June 3, the day after the primary. Her campaign waited until July 20 to agree. When KOB picked October 8 as a compromise between both campaigns, she said she couldn't make it. Every date she offered instead falls after early voting begins on October 6.
That isn't a scheduling problem. It's a strategy: keep voters from seeing her on a debate stage until they've already started casting ballots.
**New Mexico voters aren't a sideshow.** They're the whole point. They deserve to see both candidates answer tough questions, side by side, before a single ballot is cast. If **Deb Haaland thinks answering to them is beneath her** , that tells you exactly how she would govern.
**I'll be at KOB on October 8 at 6 p.m., just like I said I would.** There will be two podiums on that stage. Whether she fills hers is up to her.
If she won't face voters on a debate stage, you know she’ll fill the airwaves with attack ads using her out of state money. So I'll have to make sure voters hear from me everywhere else: on TV, in their mailboxes, and on their phones in every corner of this state before early voting opens. That's less than two weeks away, and I intend to make every day count. Will you chip in $25, $50, or $100 right now to help me reach every voter before October 6?

name: Roy Cooper
subject: You stood out
body:
I’m not reaching out to everyone today – just a select few, including you.
| [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1440&source=&t=1&akid=3843%2E124072%2E1r2mDX) | | | |

Peter, I’m not reaching out to everyone today – just a select few, including you.
My team was going through our supporter records, and we noticed how yours stood out from the crowd. You’re one of my most attentive grassroots supporters. You’ve been getting these emails for a while now, and we see you're keeping up with the latest on this election. I want you to know that _I know_ how engaged you’ve been with our campaign and how much I appreciate it.
**Today, I’m asking you to take the next step. Here's why:**
Grassroots fundraising has really slowed down these last few weeks, and it couldn’t come at a worse time. Republican super PACs have already been pouring just over $100 million so far into North Carolina to defeat me, and now, a super PAC aligned with President Trump is unleashing millions more to double down on their attacks.
Since recent polls show this race statistically tied, we need to turn this around fast – and the first step is reaching our $5 million end-of-quarter goal before our last quarterly FEC deadline on Wednesday night. [**_Will you chip in $5 right now to help us get there in time? The stakes could not be higher._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1440&amount=5&t=8&akid=3843%2E124072%2E1r2mDX)
North Carolina is the best chance Democrats have to flip one of the four seats we need to take back the Senate, so if we lose here, we lose our shot at flipping the majority. The only way we’ll avoid that is by building the resources to compete with the massive amounts of GOP spending.
**Unlike my MAGA opponent Michael Whatley, I’m not a Washington DC insider who can rely on his billionaire connections to buy this Senate seat. I’m depending on people like you, giving what you can, when you can, at crucial moments like this.**
_With a little more than five weeks to go until Election Day, Peter, I need you._
[**_Time’s running out, so I’m personally asking: Will you please chip in your first $5 donation to my campaign today so we can reach our ambitious end-of-quarter goal before the FEC deadline, flip North Carolina’s critical seat and help Democrats secure the Senate majority?_**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1440&amount=5&t=9&akid=3843%2E124072%2E1r2mDX)

# [](https://act.electjon.com/go/4629?t=1&akid=2940%2E5691347%2EhF85LU)

Peter, it’s Jon.
I don’t love asking for money. Does anyone?

_I can’t win without you._ _I can’t keep this Senate seat out of MAGA’s hands without you._
I’ll explain more in a minute, but if you’re already on board, please use this link to give before my end-of-quarter fundraising deadline:

Ok, here’s the situation in Georgia.
I am the only Democratic Senator running for reelection in a state Trump won in 2024.
That makes me MAGA’s #1 target. _And they are not waiting until November to start attacking me._

body:
Health Care Fraud Costs Taxpayers $17.5 Billion!

[INSIDE JW]

JUDICIAL WATCH SUES ODNI FOR DOCUMENTS EXPOSING 2020 ELECTION
CORRUPTION

[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85650&L=38739&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cueW91dHViZS5jb20vd2F0Y2g/dj02UDFMSEVuWHM3cyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=&hash=6848b588f89f16ee2db118c7c57be7ad735830856be2b2fd6ca25ee752eb45d4]

Trump administration agencies are withholding documents that were left
haphazardly by the Biden administration. They may well expose that
administration's corruption.

We filed a Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) lawsuit against the
Office of the Director of National Intelligence (ODNI) for Biden-era
documents discovered by former Intelligence Director Tulsi Gabbard
after she took office, which she said contain information regarding
corruption of the 2020 election (_Judicial Watch Inc. v. Office of the
Director of National Intelligence_
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85650&L=38734&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtb2RuaS1idXJuLWJhZ3MtY29tcGxhaW50LTAzMjc3Lz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=&hash=19947c4cf31be0b18bcff221c62c68b4126a3eedf926b7c82274fc5ad84162f3]
(Case 1:26-cv-03277)).

We sued in the U.S. District Court for the District of Columbia after
the ODNI failed to respond to a July 31, 2026, FOIA request “for
records concerning the discovery, location, contents, and handling of
the materials referenced by Director Gabbard, as well as
communications about their discovery and records about any inquiry
into why the materials were designated for destruction.”

On August 26, 2025, Gabbard confirmed
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85650&L=38740&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cueW91dHViZS5jb20vd2F0Y2g/dj1vTkszVzk4VWZBOCZ0PSZ1dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=&hash=df403aafa9eaa6cab4c481da34548dbc3b554cc31c71e849d075a3089e8de15d] to President Trump
during a cabinet meeting that ODNI had identified burn bags containing
information regarding corruption in the 2020 presidential election.
“We are finding documents literally tucked away in the back of safes
in random offices, in these bags and in other areas—which, again,
speaks to the intent of those who are trying to hide the truth from
the American people.” She added that the documents revealed the
politicization of intelligence and caused immeasurable harm to the
American people.

We say in our suit:

> As of the date of this Complaint, ODNI has failed to: (i) determine
> whether to comply with the request; (ii) notify Plaintiff of any
> such determination or the reasons therefor; (iii) advise Plaintiff
> of the right to appeal any adverse determination; or (iv) produce
> the requested records or otherwise demonstrate that the requested
> records are exempt from production.

There is no legitimate reason to continue sitting on these documents
that will likely add further evidence of the corruption at the top of
the Biden administration.

We have another similar suit pending.

In August, a federal judge
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85650&L=38735&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9qLWZiaS1oaWRkZW4tcm9vbS1hdWctb3JkZXItMDQwNDcvXW9yZGVyZWQ/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE&hash=c07409d710eed900d2fb63ad138294cf0a4b3f29b3ad175d63ace7452fe96034
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85650&L=38539&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9qLWZiaS1oaWRkZW4tcm9vbS1hdWctb3JkZXItMDQwNDcvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==&hash=619e37051d628ce436278df61ef62f65f1b815b3d927adc42dcebe9e037b0571]
the U.S. Department of Justice to provide answers about nearly 2
million pages of FBI records discovered in a “hidden room” at FBI
headquarters, including whether the records have already been reviewed
in response to other Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) requests and
whether the newly uncovered records had been stored in other
government record systems.

In July, the FBI
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85650&L=38741&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvaGlkZGVuLXJvb20tcmVjb3Jkcy8/X3JlY29tbWVuZGF0aW9uc19kYXRhPWV5SndiM05wZEdsdmJpSTZOWDA9XXRvbGQmdXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE&hash=1984396e2effe28ec6f0976e7f54ca9dcb7e84f75a8a5b274bef11a80dbad9aa
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85650&L=38742&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvaGlkZGVuLXJvb20tcmVjb3Jkcy8/X3JlY29tbWVuZGF0aW9uc19kYXRhPWV5SndiM05wZEdsdmJpSTZOWDA9JnV0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==&hash=cce53b3c98fb154de81a8adbf9a20bc242e97e9431cfd438ed2a0eb1eb512aab]
a federal court that, at a rate of 500 pages a month, processing
records from the “hidden room” at FBI Headquarters would take
approximately 158 years. The room — now dubbed the “burn bag
room” — holds over 2 million pages of records, according to the
FBI’s own filing. Then-Deputy Director Bongino said in May 2025 that
some of the records were found stashed “in bags.”

In February, we filed the FOIA
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85650&L=38737&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9qLWJ1cm4tYmFncy1jb21wbGFpbnQtMDA1MzgvXWxhd3N1aXQ/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE&hash=e244f2e3a2f0e0bf02720da901f075c9f45a80c8bbba921f62334b4665c4f9ca
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85650&L=37196&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9qLWJ1cm4tYmFncy1jb21wbGFpbnQtMDA1MzgvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==&hash=e5915d46cf457c801aeea210464e69744e04b8d44cb21046540b419fa4888f05]
against the U.S. Department of Justice concerning the discovery and
contents of “burn bags” found in a secured Sensitive Compartmented
Information Facility (SCIF) at Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI)
headquarters in Washington, DC.

JUDGE ORDERS HEARING IN LAWSUIT AGAINST THE CIA FOR JANUARY 6 RECORDS

We appeared this week before a federal judge in Washington, DC. who
ordered a
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85650&L=38743&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtY2lhLWo2LXJlY29yZHMtaGVhcmluZy0wMjE3Mi9dc3RhdHVzP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==&hash=c05f03c2ca5f6743478a14628256c8ffd75268a462bc7a38f81f0c6394ddb47f
conference
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85650&L=38719&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtY2lhLWo2LXJlY29yZHMtaGVhcmluZy0wMjE3Mi8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE&hash=e478547c827ca152f2dee67155b53170ed2b3658c7c7c9a1fcfc12c1d4bc85b2]
in our
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85650&L=38744&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvamFudWFyeS02LTIwMjEtcHJvdGVzdHMvXWxhd3N1aXQ/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE&hash=1c13f22b8d89fc40c018ed1c388890deb3c11efa719bdc9160326a156866a642
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85650&L=33154&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvamFudWFyeS02LTIwMjEtcHJvdGVzdHMvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==&hash=fbd7da423dcd47ec9e27bad9db21a35a6b6025de8f77d840bc0f33709cf501cd] against the
Central Intelligence Agency (CIA) for all records related to events on
January 6, 2021, in the U.S. Capitol. The status conference was held
Thursday, September 24.

Peter,
My team launched a new goal to reach $25,000 by September 30. Here’s why that matters:
Elon Musk has announced he’s spending millions of dollars in this year’s midterm elections to bankroll the MAGA agenda across the country. Last election, he spent **over $260 million** to help elect Donald Trump.
The National Republican Senatorial Committee has over **$18 million** on hand going into September, and that’s after they have spent over **$46 million** in coordinated campaign spending.
The GOP’s top three national committees entered September with a combined total of **over $233 million** cash on hand. This is a lot of money they are spending against us.
All of this dark money flooding into our races — from super PACS to megadonors — are attempts to keep the Republican majority in Congress that has not delivered for working families.
**The stakes are too high.** If we don’t fight back this year to take back Congress, we won’t be able to put a stop to the MAGA agenda and we’ll continue to see devastating cuts to Medicare, Social Security, attacks on reproductive freedom, continuing the illegal war in Iran, and so much more.
While I’m not on the ballot this year, **my number one priority** is to reclaim the Senate majority and elect Democrats up and down the ballot in Wisconsin. With you on our side, we can do just that.
We only have four days to reach $25,000. Reaching this goal will help us send a signal that everyday people are on our side — not megadonors or super PACs willing to write big checks — and that we’re ready to fight back with strong grassroots support.

Tammy Baldwin

name: Ilhan Omar
subject: “Ongoing criminal investigation”
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260926-io.8KfN78&refcode=em20260926-38295&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=1002&akid=38295%2E1203867%2EiiFEpD ]Post on X from @FoxNews: "Rep. Ilhan Omar is under "criminal"
investigation for potential immigration and marriage fraud, according to
border czar Tom Homan. Homan confirms that DHS is conducting an "ongoing
criminal investigation" involving Rep. Omar, but isn't saying what
investigators have found or whether any charges are coming."

Peter, as
I’ve said time and time again, this is a load of BS.

But I will say it again so it’s as clear as possible: I’m not at all
worried about these investigations, because they are complete shams.

And the Trump administration knows they have nothing. They make bold
claims, but it’s all talk. The entire point is to intimidate progressives
like me while getting outlets like Fox News to write headlines that
appease the MAGA base.

It helps them distract their die-hard supporters from the fact that gas
prices are skyrocketing, their healthcare is being taken away, the economy
is slowing, and we’re stuck in a stupid war with Iran.

And of course, it helps them raise money. One comment from a DHS official
about an “ongoing criminal investigation” gives Republicans all they need
to fundraise endlessly off the lies.

So, I’m reaching out today to ask for your help in countering these
right-wing attacks by doing some fundraising of our own.

We’re looking to raise $10,000 this week to put right back into our
organizing efforts here in Minnesota, where we have critical races for
Senate, Governor, Attorney General, and more coming up in just a few
weeks.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260926-io.8KfN78&refcode=em20260926-38295&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=1003&akid=38295%2E1203867%2EiiFEpD ]We are fighting each and every day to defeat MAGA at the ballot box and
bring their agenda to a screeching halt. Can you chip in any amount and
help us press on in the face of the Trump administration’s threats,
attacks, and investigations?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260926-io.8KfN78&refcode=em20260926-38295&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=1022&akid=38295%2E1203867%2EiiFEpD ]Contribute $10

Peter,
we are on the right side of history. The side of justice, fairness, peace,
and equality.

As long as I have a big progressive movement by my side, fighting for the
future we believe in, these investigations mean nothing. I’m not going
anywhere — you can bet on that.

We will not be intimidated. We will win, together.

In solidarity,

Ilhan Omar

Contribute to Justice Democrats: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/justicedemocrats?refcode=em20260926-38295-footer&t=1023&refcode2=38295_1203867_iiFEpD&akid=38295%2E1203867%2EiiFEpD

body:
Not what I spent my time doing

|
Peter,
I’ll be honest with you... I’m not great at asking for money. It’s the part of this job I hate the most.
I didn’t spend my twenties learning how to fundraise to run for office. I spent them flying H-46 helicopters for the Navy and deploying to the Persian Gulf.
And when I came home, I didn’t become a lobbyist who took clients out to expensive dinners. I used my GI Bill to become a Geriatric Nurse Practitioner. My "networking" was holding the hands of our seniors and listening to their stories, not cutting backroom deals.
That’s really who I am...a Helicopter Pilot...a Nurse Practitioner... and a Mom trying to raise four happy and healthy kids in a world that feels like it’s going in the wrong direction most days.
[I didn't run for Congress for the title. I ran because I looked at the country my children were inheriting, and I felt sick to my stomach. I couldn't just sit there.](https://trk.join.jenforcongress._cmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmYW1vdW50PTM1JmV4X3RpZD0yMDI2MDkyNl9SSC1NOS4xMTAxMTdfdDIwMzgwMDQtMjA2OCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249MjAyNjA5MjZfUkgtTTkuMTEwMTE3X3QyMDM4MDA0LTIwNjgifQ/I1Lew6PB1p26rf-oiGxWkQ)
But here is the hard truth: fighting the radical Left and standing up for our values is incredibly expensive. I don’t have a massive machine behind me. I don’t have someone who can write blank checks on a whim.
[I just have normal folks like you.](https://trk.join.jenforcongress._cmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmYW1vdW50PTM1JmV4X3RpZD0yMDI2MDkyNl9SSC1NOS4xMTAxMTdfdDIwMzgwMDQtMjA2OCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249MjAyNjA5MjZfUkgtTTkuMTEwMTE3X3QyMDM4MDA0LTIwNjgifQ/-My7QnAHgppKXnRuPg1rlQ)
I know things are tight right now. I see it at the grocery store just like you do. But if you can spare even $5 to help keep a Navy Vet and a Nurse Practitioner in this fight, it would mean the world to me.

**Good morning!** On this day in 1960, the [first televised U.S. presidential debate](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGuozAQheGngc7IHhwIhYtt6LLtlmgI4zAbYyN7BMvbr3J13-DWn3SO9P95TA_kwPH1Gzdy4tMU6SyBRChPnDFu-KaSvKe8p50OLiw-T6ChU3pQ0E34FD5oslgvzhMBtTU50w_amt60ul7d3N9bi9rYzgyAw6xJt9C15raQR6S-ZvfZ0wN0RusbDA34wc73p9EArcX-VllNC0vKzd_EUVby4UoH5eaZtjq4VWQvVfurgrGC8TzPZuUiKV8fr2CUlYta8FIc1bdUMHrORdSbYqTlUpH_pagWmlGozm7ZTw6BS9dXVr825PD1JT9MdDj4HwAA__8bvXz9) aired live from Chicago, featuring Democratic Sen. John F. Kennedy and Vice President Richard M. Nixon discussing domestic issues. Everything old is new again. Fifty-four years after President Nixon brought pandas Ling-Ling and Hsing-Hsing from China to the National Zoo in Washington, China is now sending America another pair of pandas. Americans lined up by the thousands to see the popular pandas, but China eventually called them home as international relations soured. New pairs have since landed in San Diego and Washington, and now it's Atlanta's turn again. [You can read about it](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLFutDAQhJ_GdEZmDeZcuPgbuvvblGgP1ocTY5C9B8nbR9wrpBvNSN9o5uM-3jHEkJ7_cSXHfhsTnSUSM-UxZEwrflHZvKe8bzsdoQT2eQQFRiorwYw4cThobLGanScC0hW5preqbfpGq2pxRje-0V1_M-RbUMoi3oxGY-deo3rYKriLpyyYRqkObA3eto_b1CgA3WLfiVbRHHjL9ecWEi_k4892UK6nba2iW5j3IvQ_AYOA4TzPekqP6QoFDBdawKDspTsBw7SEhPJV5HeQnF_rLt-r5I5pRln4NVPiy0NZL7zGKrt5P0OMoZhetOq5YojvZv7jYYeD3wAAAP__7_5-sA) in today's _Et Cetera_ section. name: Team Pramila
subject: Why next Wednesday is so important
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
Wednesday, September 30th is our final end-of-quarter fundraising deadline before the midterms.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20260926-6767-footer&t=1&akid=6767%2E420207%2E5id9Af)
Peter,
We’ll get right to it: Wednesday, September 30th is our final end-of-quarter fundraising deadline before the midterms.
**It’s also the last time our numbers will go public before Election Day.**
Everyone will be looking at those reports as a sign of the strength of our movement—from reporters to the far-right billionaires and dark money groups who’ve spent _millions_ trying to stop us.
[**Peter, can we count on you to pitch in $3 before Wednesday’s deadline to help us reach our $175,000 end-of-quarter goal?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20260926-1.bfP9_t&refcode=em20260926-6767&amount=3&t=2&akid=6767%2E420207%2E5id9Af)
Your support is critical here. Pramila doesn’t take corporate PAC money, and she doesn’t have billionaires on speed dial to cut a check at the drop of a hat.
**Our report won’t show a handful of giant checks supporting this campaign — it will show thousands of regular people pitching in an average donation of $26 at a time.**
A strong report will tell everyone who looks that our movement has momentum. It tells our opponents that spending money against us is a waste of their time. And it tells every fellow progressive that people-powered campaigns can _win._
A weak report would do the opposite, giving the far-right an opening in the final weeks before the election. And that’s the last thing we want right now.
[**So before this final FEC deadline on Wednesday, will you pitch in $3 or whatever you can to help us show everyone just how strong our movement really is?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20260926-1.bfP9_t&refcode=em20260926-6767&amount=3&t=3&akid=6767%2E420207%2E5id9Af)
**[Contribute $3](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20260926-1.bfP9_t&amount=3&refcode=em20260926-6767&t=22&akid=6767%2E420207%2E5id9Af)**
In solidarity,
Team Pramila

---
_You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you only want our most important email updates,[click here.](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/108?t=2&akid=3236%2E259176%2El6n0tI) If you'd like to unsubscribe, [click here.](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/109?t=3&akid=3236%2E259176%2El6n0tI)_

---
BREAKING: Cook Political Report just shifted this race _in our favor._
That means two things:

1. Our strategy of building a winning coalition and calling out the status quo is _working._

2. Aaron Flint and his big money backers are going to do everything in their power to stop us.

**It’s crunch time.** We have to be prepared for anything the opposition throws our way in light of today’s news, from airing more ads against us to spreading misinformation about this race.

That’s why a super PAC backing Aaron Flint is already spending $2,000,000 in ads against us.

**But we have a grassroots movement on our side.**

As we’ve traveled throughout the district, I’ve spoken with folks from all walks of life. Teachers, nurses, mechanics, you name it — and what I’ve heard has been consistent:

_We’re being left behind by the same people who say they’re fighting for us.

Costs keep soaring with no end in sight.

And it’s not going to get any better unless we choose a different kind of leadership. _

I know what it’s like to put in hundreds of hours of overtime just to still hang on by my fingernails. We deserve better, and that’s why I’ll put working people first in Congress – not corporate interests.

Sam Forstag

name: The PreBorn! Team
subject: One Text Message Changed Everything.
body:
When Isabella told the father of her baby she was pregnant, she was hoping for encouragement.

| | | | [](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckU-L3DAMxT-Nc8vgkTNOc8hhaQj0sKU9dHsMGlnxmMZ_sJ20H79kmYWee9N7Ej-hp5-vyyu6zQX7FT2PdLgllyUGrvynei4FLdMDg2XDB-cFJOhWDi3oBam6g5cOGzOS0QoaHq_9ILvrcFOyeYyrVEirXDUxrQASZEefEJVBNax0Gxo3njg5gL7K7gb9pdP3XqLWPd9JoupFJ_dksHK5UAyF84HnThdCPKsYLhR9s42PWlMR6kXALGC27nDBXlLme8zvIwLmpxIw04PpV9yrgBlTYtxKi7uRPejNCzUXEmp6-XHqbwI0oU_obBBq6tQVQArQe_VLiXsmFmpKOZbEVF2wz5Zn43Yv1MQe3fY0_-E4n5Dqhx9D5VCFmt665Xvffn770n6k0uTRpN9u21zRZxb25L2fXP_zU8cIfwMAAP__pnykYQ)
---
**Friend of Life,** When Isabella told the father of her baby she was pregnant, she was hoping for encouragement. Instead, she received a single text message. **"Abort."** Already grieving the loss of her toddler's father to cancer, Isabella suddenly found herself carrying another child without the support she desperately needed. Fear quickly gave way to hopelessness, and she became convinced there was only one way out of the situation she was facing. Then something unexpected happened. Instead of making a permanent decision she could never take back, Isabella found her way to a PreBorn! Network Clinic, where she was welcomed with compassion and surrounded by people who cared about both her and her baby. They listened to her story, answered her questions, talked honestly about parenting and adoption, and shared the hope of Jesus Christ with her. As those conversations continued, our staff introduced Isabella to Cari and Christian, a couple who had spent years praying that God would bless them with the opportunity to adopt a little girl. Months later, when Isabella gave birth, she spent 80 precious hours holding her daughter before placing her into Cari and Christian's arms. Then she quietly said the words they will never forget: **"You are going to be parents to Liliana."** What Isabella didn't know was that Cari and Christian had already chosen that very name years earlier while praying for the daughter they hoped God would one day provide. Only God could write a story like that. Every day at PreBorn!, we meet women who believe their circumstances will define the rest of their lives. Time and again, God reminds us that His plans are often greater than anything we could imagine. Your generosity helps make those moments possible. A gift of **$28 helps provide one life-saving ultrasound** , giving another woman the opportunity to slow down, receive compassionate care, and hear that both she and her baby are deeply loved by Jesus Christ. And because of a generous matching challenge, **every gift made before September 30 will be MATCHED dollar for dollar, up to $100,000.** Will you help another woman discover that hope is never beyond God's reach?
---

**Good morning!** On this day in 1906, Joseph A. Kemp and Frank Kell chartered the [Wichita Falls and Northwestern Railway Company of Texas](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLtuwzAMAL_G3mzQ9KsaNHTxlq4dDdqmI6KKFEhElPx9kf5C98MdcN-X9ULiJVy_6MZWn2dcA5fsWZXTmpWUT5IU7xzywRsp7468XxFwasA0OK20qzx4Hag-7AaH6Wq23WxgQBgM1s5uPX8M3KOZDSDu1I8jG8DJbGaGc6Za7FsHBqeug66HdqQO6ZzPYcYOcBqrAfgQjalVx8pPyqd_xQendo-32lunes9V_1nhUuFSSmk1O4rBS-A2pmuFi6NwbDH-VLhw0CSc36TsTpSak7zPDYWjCTGpK5yVU2gSiS_0qpM97kW8lzzN1QDXG4n_K-t_jz0s_gYAAP__qtSCjw) to build a 17-mile line from Wichita Falls to the Red River. The race for Maine is rated a true toss-up by every independent forecaster watching it, and the margin separating me from my opponent, Troy Jackson, is inside the margin of error in poll after poll. Will you make a contribution of $25 right now to help us meet this moment?

Whichever party controls the Senate controls the Senate committee gavels, the confirmation votes, and the legislative calendar for the next two years. National money is pouring in on both sides because both sides know exactly what is at stake.
I have built a reputation as a Senator who reads the bills, asks the hard questions, and votes my conscience and never misses a vote. That reputation is on the ballot with me this November. It cannot defend itself against a flood of outside spending.
So I am asking you directly, not through a consultant, not through a form letter. A gift of $25, $50, or whatever you can manage today goes straight into keeping our campaign competitive through the final stretch. Every dollar and every day matters more now than at any point in this race.

name: Roy Cooper
subject: Your personal endorsement
body:
I’m aiming to gather 25,000 signatures before the end of the day.
| [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_su_pros_jtk1450&source=&t=1&akid=3972%2E124072%2EFEzBtE) | | | |
---
[](https://act.roycooper.com/survey/mscl-endorse-cooper-0626-email/?source=email_su_pros_jtk1450&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&ask=5&askdif=25&t=8&akid=3972%2E124072%2EFEzBtE)
Peter, I’ve been crisscrossing the state on my Make Stuff Cost Less campaign tour, talking with and listening to North Carolinians directly, and I keep hearing versions of the same thing:
🚨 Everything from gas to groceries is getting unaffordable.

🏠 Buying a house and planning for the future seems unthinkable.

🇺🇲 The American Dream feels unattainable.
**Stuff costs too much, and nobody in Washington DC seems to care.**
When I hear things like this, I know it’s time to get to work. That’s why I’m in this fight. As North Carolina’s next U.S. Senator, I will put the people before power, party and politics – as I did for eight years as Governor:
✅ We expanded Medicaid for hundreds of thousands of working North Carolinians.

✅ We added hundreds of thousands of good-paying jobs.

✅ We increased teacher pay and expanded paid parental leave.
**Now, I’m ready to bring this North Carolina common sense to the U.S. Senate – but I need your help. The GOP is going all in to defeat me, and only by building a powerful grassroots team can I fight back and win.**
[**_Peter, will you add your name now to personally endorse my campaign for Senate? I’m aiming to gather 25,000 signatures before the end of the day, and it would mean a lot to have you with me in this fight._**](https://act.roycooper.com/survey/mscl-endorse-cooper-0626-email/?source=email_su_pros_jtk1450&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&ask=5&askdif=25&t=9&akid=3972%2E124072%2EFEzBtE)

Thank you,

Roy Cooper

[](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_su_pros_jtk1450&t=2&akid=3972%2E124072%2EFEzBtE)
Democrat Roy Cooper is running for U.S. Senate to help take back the Majority for Democrats. North Carolina is Democrats’ best chance to flip a seat from red to blue — the path to stopping Republicans in Washington starts here.

National Republicans will target North Carolina as a key battleground and invest heavily in defeating us.

Cooper is a former state legislator, Attorney General, and most recently Governor of North Carolina. North Carolina will be the most competitive Senate election of 2026, and Cooper enters the race as the most formidable candidate of either party.

Cooper’s signature achievements include helping to expand Medicaid and helping make NC the top state for business by creating thousands of jobs and growing the clean energy economy.

Friend of the podcast, Dr. Robert Malone recently asked a question on his Substack that ought to stop every American cold: "when the grocery store is gone, who will feed you?" It sounds rhetorical. It isn't. The lights above America's grocery aisles are going out, store by store, town by town -- and what's replacing them is worse than an empty storefront. It's dependence.
Start with the arithmetic, because nobody in Washington seems to be doing it. In 2026, for yet another straight year, more grocery stores will close in this country than open. Albertsons and Safeway announced an "optimization plan" -- corporate-speak for closing dozens of stores while still planning executive bonuses. Winn-Dixie and Harveys are shuttering locations across the Southeast -- twelve in Louisiana, eighteen in Alabama, more in Georgia and Mississippi. Kroger, Giant Food, and Aldi are trimming doors as well. And where do the closures cluster? Not in the wealthy suburbs. They cluster in poor neighborhoods and small towns -- the places least able to lose a store.

body:
The midterms are our chance to put a real check on Trump's power before 2028.

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=3038%2E4032634%2EqYWrlG)
---
Donald Trump’s favorite subject is Donald Trump. His name and face are showing up everywhere:
* **Trump Bank:** A Trump-appointed regulator conditionally approved a bank charter for World Liberty Trust, a Trump family-linked crypto business, clearing the way for its own stablecoin and potentially more profits for the Trump family.
* **Trump TV:** After banning CNN, Politico, and MS NOW from the White House, Trump launched a 24/7 propaganda YouTube channel. Apparently Truth Social wasn't enough.
* **Trump coins:** The U.S. Mint is selling a 24-karat gold coin with Trump's portrait, plus a 2026 $1 coin with his face on it.
* **Trump's signature on our money:** Treasury says his signature will appear on future paper currency, making him the first sitting president to put his name on American bills.
* **Trump's crypto cash:** Trump reported more than $1.4 billion in income from his family's crypto ventures in 2025.

And that’s not even to mention his administration floating a $100 million triumphal arch bearing his name, turning the White House lawn into a UFC event for his 80th birthday, or Republicans in Congress proposing $1 billion in federal funding for Trump's planned White House ballroom. Sure, he's vain. But this is about more than vanity. Trump has hijacked the presidency and turned it into a personal grift machine, using the power of the office to benefit himself, his family, his brand, and his wealth. It’s corruption. Plain and simple. All while he’s stripping health care from millions, starting unfounded wars, letting ICE detain children, rigging district maps to lock themselves in power forever, and cutting funding for critical government programs to give his friends tax breaks. Trump gets away with this because Republicans in Congress let him. This November, we can change that. If we win back the House and Senate, we stop the worst of his agenda. We block his extreme judges. We hold him accountable. And we pass plans that actually help working families, not just Donald Trump. But we have to act now. September and October are make-or-break months for winning the midterms, and Trump's side has billionaires and crypto money behind them. We have something stronger: people who are fed up and ready to fight. [**If you’re able, will you please pitch in $28 or anything you can to help support this movement and guarantee Democrats beat MAGA Republicans in the midterms and stop Trump’s ego-driven decision-making?**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/3812?amount=28&t=8&akid=3038%2E4032634%2EqYWrlG)

Hillsdale College's popular online course, **" The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives,"** is now FREE on DVD.

In this six-lecture course, you'll explore some of the major themes of Genesis, including the complex relationship between God and man, and what it reveals about divine and human nature.

"The Genesis Story" is taught by Hillsdale College professor of English Justin Jackson, who has taught the subject to undergraduate students here at the College for 15 years. This course aims to deepen a student's theological understanding of the Old Testament by revealing the literary beauty and complexity of the text.

The course begins with a lecture and introduction by the president of Hillsdale College, Larry P. Arnn, in which he explains why we teach the Book of Genesis at Hillsdale College and why it's important to both faith and higher education.

Then, Dr. Jackson explains the four relationships that dominate the Book of Genesis: God and creation, God and man, man and man, and man and creation.

You'll explore these relationships in the narratives of Adam and Eve, Abraham and Sarah, Abraham and Isaac, Jacob and Esau, and finally, Joseph.

This course on DVD is perfect for viewing in your home with your family or for use in small groups such as Bible studies and book clubs.

**To receive your FREE Genesis DVD box set, please use the secure link here:**[https://info.hillsdale.edu/-genesis-free-dvd-offer](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckcGOnDAMhp8m3EDBZBhy4NAKqLbqTtVy6BGF2DCWIIlImFXfvhpp9gUq3_xJn-X___M-vRve2K03s1PLMU7ocfq4_13JUeTn7MEfybiU_GImkFDnUudQT8YmftCkTIbtBcpmaTJqy6uWClTZlNm9RcKmLI3S2lZynssZFRLoSy3RmGq2GbdPn9RQlyDhootmNrNEDXgtlUaohZJnQJOoYBcZKVrvQ_AbJ7ax8Meabe09pRBF9UXAIGBgt_jiztsW0WxUEJ4Chvz1Tb4cRDk-MPfLQoeohmhF1UmpVX2ToODH96_dz67vRwH1mfYp-vOwJKouHD4Gsond-kI7IZ-7qDraDW-vpTV7MLw6UXWvkxM-8BN6l8glUXXf-ls_vo3D776ffl3zt3HMP4PIjhbDB28bx_oqlFyf9sL6PUv_W8-jhX8BAAD___cFoQI)

Peter, This is a short note, but I think you need to hear it. Donald Trump and Republicans came into this election with a plan: Rig the maps, suppress the vote, and hold on to all the power by any means necessary. I wanted to reach out today because I think that plan is failing. And that’s in large part because of you and this grassroots team. name: Douglas Carswell
subject: Why is Mississippi so AWESOME?
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/mspolicy/whyismssoawesome?e=5703353baa)
---
| |
---
| _**If you're not in front of our Saturday email, you're behind.**_
---
| Dear Friend,
When I first moved to Mississippi almost six years ago, a few of my friends in London seemed puzzled. Why move from London to Jackson? Like many people who do not know the South, they seemed to have an outdate idea about our state. When they heard the word Mississippi, they thought of a river, or a riverboat, or cotton fields. Their view was clouded by every Hollywood cliché about our state over the past fifty years. I think that image of our state is changing. America is noticing that Mississippi is on the up. Fourth graders in Mississippi read better than fourth graders in California, New York or Minnesota. New York spends more than $30,000 a year to educate — or not educate — a child. Mississippi gets better grades on half the money. Agriculture is vital for our state, but our state is also about advanced manufacturing. The past couple of weeks alone have seen a string of announcements made about yet more inward investment. SubSea Craft is bringing 56 jobs to Hancock County. Hitachi Energy is putting $528 million into its transformer plant in Copiah County. General Atomics is investing $87 million in Shannon. And that is just the past couple of weeks! Last Thursday, my friend Nic Horton, who runs our sister organization in Arkansas, Opportunity Arkansas, invited me to take part in a discussion about how free market reforms are changing Mississippi for the better.
---
|
---
**_Explaining Mississippi’s free market wins ....._**
| I explained some of the big policy wins we have had in Mississippi over the past few years, which have transformed the trajectory of our state. Here are the key reforms that made this success possible.
---
|
---
**_The reforms elevating our state ...._**
| What was striking was listening to policy think tanks from other southern states, and realizing that no one in the South is standing still. Almost every SEC state is now making impressive reforms. Arkansas matched our income tax reform. When we lowered our rate to 4 percent, they deliberately set theirs at 3.9 percent. This year they cut it again, to 3.7 percent. Even so, Speaker White's legislation to eliminate the income tax now puts us in the lead. We are the first state to legislate to remove its income tax since Alaska in 1980. Mississippi might have made progress with school funding reform in 2024, so that money follows the student, not the system. But Arkansas and Alabama have now gone one better. They allow families to control their child's share of the education budget, and to spend those school dollars at any school of their choice. Mississippi's progress in cutting the red tape that holds back health care is a real step in the right direction. But it is worth reflecting how many other southern states got rid of these protectionist regulations years ago. A generation ago, Texas, Florida, Georgia and North Carolina started to take off economically. For too long, Mississippi was not part of that southern success story, and ours was a state that young people left. Thanks to free market reforms, this is starting to change. Mississippi is not just part of the southern success story, but part of the new American Boom Belt. If you want the ultimate proof, look and see where young Americans are choosing to go to college.
---
|
---
**_Finding freedom in the South ....._**
| Since 2014, there has been extraordinary growth in the number of young people from the Northeast seeking to escape “woke” campus life. Ole Miss undergraduate enrollment from the Northeast rose about 230% from 2014 to 2023, and more than 60% of its freshmen now come from out of state. Alabama’s incoming class went from roughly 23% out-of-state in 2002 to about 65% in 2022. They can’t just be here for the football. Young people know that if they come south to study, they can find freedom and opportunity at SEC colleges. Thanks to free-market reforms, those same young people will have tremendous opportunity when they graduate. It’s never felt better to be from Mississippi than it feels like today!

__Every single__ political consultant and Washington insider told me not to do it. They said we had to raise a lot of money to win (which was true) and it'd be a mistake to turn away that money — especially ‘easy’ money.

Elissa Slotkin

# [Cuyahoga County Should Not Let Metanoia Disappear Over $250,000](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=7924944&post_id=217524286&utm_source=cross-post&utm_campaign=3159258&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MjE3NTI0Mjg2LCJpYXQiOjE3OTA0MjkwNDAsImV4cCI6MTc5MzAyMTA0MCwiaXNzIjoicHViLTc5MjQ5NDQiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.FPcQMIiv5Lvh2MRAOk4ouZaxmj2lPMIwVO5Ayl3GHy8)
### I volunteered at this shelter. I watched it give people the time, safety and flexibility they needed to rebuild their lives.

Hey, fellow Angry Ohioans.
[Cleveland.com reported this week](https://substack.com/redirect/d38db004-0297-4f5b-8c66-41bdcfacbdcb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that the Metanoia Project does not have enough money to open its seasonal homeless shelter this winter. After nearly 20 years of operation, the entire organization could disappear by the end of the year.
Metanoia needs approximately **$250,000 to operate its shelter for six months** , from November through April. Last winter, it sheltered as many as 45 people a night.
This one is personal for me.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/fbdcde2e-d8bc-440e-918b-11fdf01ea07d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* * *
## I Saw This Work Firsthand
I volunteered at Metanoia for one winter season in 2019. I usually worked around the showers, giving people fresh towels, toiletries, socks, underwear and whatever else they needed. I also collected and donated supplies.
My ex-girlfriend and her father, both physicians, have provided pro bono medical care to people experiencing homelessness in Cleveland. Dr. Sweeney also sits on Metanoia's board. I have been connected to this organization, directly or indirectly, for nearly seven years.
I have seen the good it does.
Metanoia is not just a room filled with beds. It is a low-barrier shelter for people who cannot or will not use the traditional shelter system. Metanoia says guests do not have to meet programming requirements to receive a bed, and they can stay as long as they need. The organization provides meals, clothing, showers, laundry, resource connections and help finding housing, healthcare, employment and recovery services.
The staff bring people inside before the temperature becomes dangerous. They provide dinner, hot showers and clean bedding. More importantly, they treat people like human beings.
* * *
## The Story I Still Remember
One man I met had been in jail for a couple of months. While he was incarcerated, he could not pay his rent. He lost his apartment, and his belongings were thrown away.
When he was released, he had nothing.
He went directly to Metanoia, where he received a bed and a hot shower. That stability gave him time to look for work. Within a couple of weeks, he found a job on a construction crew. A few weeks later, he was promoted to a supervisory position managing several workers.
His boss respected his work ethic and eventually offered him a place to live in one of his properties. The man saved money, moved out of Metanoia and started rebuilding his life.
Metanoia did not solve every problem for him. It gave him the flexibility, time and safety he needed to solve those problems himself.
I met another man who was working and saving money for an apartment deposit. He needed enough savings and sufficient employment history before a landlord would approve him. Metanoia gave him somewhere safe to sleep while he put those pieces together.
These are failures in the larger system, but Metanoia gave these men an option that worked for them.
Guests repeatedly talked about the shelter's flexibility. They could keep their belongings with them. They felt safe. They respected the staff, and they believed the staff cared about them.
That is not something you can measure by simply counting how many beds exist somewhere else.
* * *
## "Other Beds Are Available" Misses the Point
County officials say the traditional shelter system has available beds and that nobody seeking shelter will be turned away.
That does not answer the actual problem.
Some people have been removed from traditional shelters. Others do not feel safe or comfortable in them. Some have partners or pets they will not abandon. Some have possessions they need to keep with them.
Metanoia exists specifically for people who fall through those cracks.
According to the Cleveland.com report, approximately **170 people were counted living outside in August**. Cuyahoga County's only other seasonal shelter can accommodate fewer than 50 people and requires a referral.
The county can say beds exist somewhere else, but that does not mean the people Metanoia serves will use them. Metanoia's own description of its mission is blunt: **its shelter exists primarily to keep people alive when they cannot or will not enter traditional shelters.**
In a Cleveland winter, this is potentially a life-or-death distinction.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/7fb3002f-c69b-4da8-9eb2-befeee31ab0b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
## We Are Talking About $250,000
Metanoia needs approximately $250,000 to operate for the entire six-month winter season.
Its funding has been drying up. According to the reporting, a funding reduction involving the ADAMHS Board cost Metanoia approximately **$90,000 annually**. The county temporarily provided a **$75,000 grant** , but that money was not guaranteed for another season.
Metanoia reportedly applied for more than 60 grants this year and was rejected by most of them. The organization is now so financially strained that it cannot afford to pay its executive director beyond this month.
For comparison, Cuyahoga County, Cleveland, EDEN and other partners recently celebrated the **$31 million redevelopment of the Norma Herr Center**. That project added 26,600 square feet, constructed 103 new beds and provided private rooms, bathrooms, accessibility improvements and other modern amenities. The total capacity will increase from 175 to 203 beds, a net increase of 28.
I am not arguing that the women staying at Norma Herr do not deserve privacy, safety and dignity. They absolutely do.
I am asking why government agencies can assemble $31 million for a major construction project, complete with a ribbon cutting and speeches, while an organization providing up to 45 people a night with shelter, food, showers and essential services **cannot find $250,000 to survive another winter.**
At its reported operating cost, Metanoia provides six months of shelter for approximately one percent of the Norma Herr redevelopment budget.
That should put this into perspective.
* * *
## This Is What Our Priorities Look Like
County leaders are asking voters for higher property taxes to fund social services. The proposed Health and Human Services levy alone would renew the existing levy and add another 2.5 mills.
At the same time, Metanoia cannot raise $250,000.
This should be an instructive moment for County Executive Chris Ronayne and every member of County Council.
The county is financially strained. Community organizations are financially strained. The people who normally donate to these organizations are financially strained. Families are dealing with higher property taxes, groceries, insurance, utilities and practically everything else.
The county's answer cannot always be to raise taxes while small organizations doing essential work are left begging for enough money to survive one more season.
Metanoia represents exactly the kind of service communities need. It does not require tens of millions of dollars in new construction. **It works through existing churches and community facilities. It brings together volunteers, medical professionals, advocates and staff members who show up and do the work.**
There is no giant new campus. There is no monument for an elected official. There is no need for political theater.
There are just people who have been doing this work for nearly 20 years on a shoestring budget and producing real stories of success.
* * *
## Do Not Let This Organization Die
Losing Metanoia would mean losing one of only two seasonal shelters serving some of the hardest-to-shelter people in Cuyahoga County.
It would mean fewer beds during a Cleveland winter.
It would mean people remaining outside who will not enter the traditional shelter system, regardless of how many times county officials insist that other beds are technically available.
It could mean people dying from exposure.
I am putting this on everyone's radar because Metanoia deserves to continue. County leaders, foundations, businesses and private donors should be working right now to find the money necessary to keep its doors open.
If you can help, [donate directly to the Metanoia Project](https://substack.com/redirect/68d0145a-ee19-4695-9cdb-3cd6f1581701?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
This organization helped people when they had nowhere else to go. It gave them food, shelter, dignity and the breathing room necessary to rebuild their lives.
Cuyahoga County should not let it disappear over $250,000.
## **Stay Angry.**

The people who normally donate to these organizations are financially strained. Families are dealing with higher property taxes, groceries, insurance, utilities and practically everything else. The county's answer cannot always be to raise taxes while small organizations doing essential work are left begging for enough money to survive one more season. Metanoia represents exactly the kind of service communities need. It does not require tens of millions of dollars in new construction. It works through existing churches and community facilities. It brings together volunteers, medical professionals, advocates and staff members who show up and do the work. There is no giant new campus. There is no monument for an elected official. There is no need for political theater. There are just people who have been doing this work for nearly 20 years on a shoestring budget and producing real stories of success. Do Not Let This Organization Die Losing Metanoia would mean losing one of only two seasonal shelters serving some of the hardest-to-shelter people in Cuyahoga County. It would mean fewer beds during a Cleveland winter. It would mean people remaining outside who will not enter the traditional shelter system, regardless of how many times county officials insist that other beds are technically available. It could mean people dying from exposure. I am putting this on everyone's radar because Metanoia deserves to continue. County leaders, foundations, businesses and private donors should be working right now to find the money necessary to keep its doors open. If you can help, . This organization helped people when they had nowhere else to go. It gave them food, shelter, dignity and the breathing room necessary to rebuild their lives. Cuyahoga County should not let it disappear over $250,000. Stay Angry.** | | | | | | | | Originally posted on | | | | Angry Democrat ---|---|--- | ? An ANGRY Ohioan Patriot? This is your home for Ohio-specific political news and commentary. (C) 2026 Matt Diemer Berea, Ohio ? ?

The following is almost entirely made up; except the facts.
**[EXT. MUSEUM ISLAND, BERLIN -- DAY]**
I'm standing in the middle of Berlin, in front of a building wrapped in scaffolding and history.
Behind me: the Pergamon Museum. For over a decade, it's been closed off to the world -- hidden behind construction barriers, its greatest treasure locked away where no visitor has seen it since 2014.
But on June 4th, 2027, the doors open again.
And what comes back into public view isn't just a museum exhibit.
Some believe it's the return... of Satan's throne.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/83d14a76-6e10-46d5-afba-71153c46da4f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**[ACT ONE -- THE MONUMENT OF THE GODS]**
Our story begins more than 2,100 years ago -- nearly 2,000 miles from here, on a windswept hilltop in ancient Asia Minor.
The city: Pergamon. One of the great power centers of the Hellenistic world.
Here, its kings built something extraordinary -- a colossal altar, roughly 35 meters square, rising from the acropolis. A staircase so massive, so dramatic, that climbing it was meant to feel like ascending into the heavens themselves.
Wrapped around it: a marble frieze, hundreds of feet long, depicting a violent cosmic war -- the Olympian gods **crushing the giants**, hurling them down in agonized, twisting stone.
Archaeologists believe it was more than art. It was propaganda -- a statement that the kings of Pergamon, like the gods, had defeated their enemies.
This was one of the wonders of the ancient world.
And it was about to play a role no one could have imagined.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/bdaa07a5-6219-43af-8dba-5346c09c7175?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**[ACT TWO -- SATAN'S THRONE?]**
Because Pergamon appears in one of the strangest passages in the Bible.
The Book of Revelation -- written roughly a century after the altar -- addresses the church in that city with a chilling line:
"I know where you dwell -- where Satan's throne is."
Revelation 2:13.
Now, historians still debate what that means. Some say it refers to this very altar. Others point to Pergamon's temples to the Roman emperors -- where worshiping the emperor was demanded of every citizen.
But one thing is certain: from the earliest days of Christianity, Pergamon had a reputation.
A dark one.
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=6729589&post_id=213450853&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MjEzNDUwODUzLCJpYXQiOjE3OTA0Mjk1MjEsImV4cCI6MTc5MzAyMTUyMSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTY3Mjk1ODkiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.7LMB808LX-xyrpd2AhP31brCHg9yd_r5GdxtH3ZVLfg)
**[ACT THREE -- THE RELIC MOVES TO BERLIN]**
Fast forward to the 1870s.
German engineers working in Ottoman Turkey uncover the altar's remains -- and in one of archaeology's most controversial salvage operations, the monument is shipped to Berlin, block by massive block.
Reassembled inside a purpose-built museum, it becomes the crown jewel of Imperial Germany's collection -- opened to the public in 1930.
Then, three years later... everything changes.
1933\. Adolf Hitler takes power.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ead88f69-42ea-41fa-8026-28491f67edb8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
His chief architect, Albert Speer, seizes on the altar's breathtaking design -- the vast stairway, the commanding heights -- as a model for Nazi architecture. Early party rallies in Berlin are staged against the backdrop of the altar itself.
When Speer designs the colossal tribune at Nuremberg's Zeppelinfeld -- the stage for Hitler's most famous rallies -- the fingerprint of Pergamon is unmistakable.
And when Leni Riefenstahl films Triumph of the Will in 1935 -- the propaganda film that defined the Nazi image -- the camera lingers on staircases and platforms built on the altar's blueprint.
The altar survives the war... barely. In 1945, Soviet troops seize it, hauling the treasure east as a trophy of victory. It disappears behind the Iron Curtain -- until 1959, when it resurfaces in East Berlin, back on display under a communist regime.
One monument. Three empires. Fourteen centuries of silence, then a century of turmoil.
And then, in 2014 -- silence again. The museum closes. The altar vanishes from public view.
For thirteen years.
**[ACT FOUR -- THE PROPHECY]**
Now -- here is where history ends and the debate begins.
Enter Jonathan Cahn -- the Messianic rabbi and bestselling author of 'The Harbinger' and 'The Return of the Gods'.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/3d6f2bf2-6347-4894-b6eb-fcca340ee1f4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Cahn's argument, laid out across his books and media appearances, is staggering in its ambition:

Millions will walk up that staircase -- the same staircase Speer traced, the same staircase Hitler's rallies once faced -- and stand before a monument of the ancient gods.
Some will see the greatest altar ever unearthed.
Some will see art.
Some will see a throne.
And a few... will see a countdown.
The stone has returned. The question -- as it has for 2,100 years -- is what it's pointing at.
I'm on Museum Island, Berlin. The doors open in months.
What do you think waits behind them?

name: Roy Cooper
subject: This is less than ideal.
body:
Falling short of our FEC goal is simply not an option.
| [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1437&source=&t=1&akid=3849%2E124072%2E2mYb6x) | | | |

Peter,
As one of the most engaged supporters of my U.S. Senate campaign in North Carolina, you have made a deep impact on our ability to stay in this fight. Thank you.
I hope you know how much I appreciate your time and attention – [**_and today, I’m asking you to take the next step and make a donation of $5._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1437&amount=5&t=9&akid=3849%2E124072%2E2mYb6x) Here’s why:
**Our final FEC end-of-quarter deadline before the election is in just four days – and we’re falling short of our goal. The timing is less than ideal.**
The GOP (including President Trump’s super PAC) is spending more than $100 million to defeat me. Trump and JD Vance just came to North Carolina to rally for my opponent and call on outside spending groups to dump even more dark money into this race. Far-right super PACs are spreading lies about me and completely distorting my record.
Now, their attacks are working: A recent poll shows my slim lead cut to a statistical tie.
Look, Peter, when this FEC deadline comes to a close, our numbers will go public. Everyone will be watching to gauge the strength of our campaign. **If we miss our goal, we’ll give the GOP an opening to double down with another buy of baseless ads against me – threatening to crush our momentum heading into the last weeks of this election.**
That’s why falling short is simply not an option. The only way we can stay on track to flip North Carolina and take back the Senate is if people like you chip in and help us close the gap.
[**_So Peter, I’m asking you to chip in right now to help us hit our FEC end-of-quarter goal and turn things around. I’d be grateful for your $5 or whatever you can spare. Every dollar makes a difference when thousands of folks like you pitch in. Will you please donate?_**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1437&amount=5&t=10&akid=3849%2E124072%2E2mYb6x)

Non-Contribution Account (For TTPAC, Inc.'s Expenditures Other Than Direct Contributions to Federal Committees)

As permitted by law, TTPAC, Inc. maintains a non-contribution account for the purpose of influencing federal, state, and local elections. Federal law requires us to use our best efforts to collect and report the name, address, occupation, and employer of individuals whose contribution exceeds $200 in an election cycle. For contributions from federal committees, corporations, and labor unions - regardless of contribution amount - federal law requires us to use our best efforts to collect and report the committee's name and address. State and local law may require us to collect and report additional information.

Contributions to this account may be used to influence federal elections by making independent expenditures in support of or in opposition to federal candidates. Additionally, in state and local jurisdictions that permit non-individual type (e.g., corporate) contributions directly to candidates and/or committees, contributions to this account may be used for both independent expenditures and direct contributions to candidates and/or committees, as permitted by state and local law.

name: United We Dream
subject: Peter, no one organizes alone here
body:
Here's the unglamorous work behind every new organizer. | | | Peter, Today, young organizers across the country do the work people often don’t see when it comes to organizing: building lasting relationships, trust, and community. From organizing a Know Your Rights session in Texas to a rock climbing day in Chicago and an art gathering in California, effective organizing cannot happen without community building. On the surface, these events might look simple. A room. Some snacks. A sign-in sheet. _Here's what you don't see: the relationships being built in that room and beyond. Neighbors meeting neighbors. Classmates realizing they're facing the same fears. People on the same block learning they can count on each other._ We can't organize people we don't know. Every action and every win starts with relationships in our communities, on our blocks, and in our schools. That's what these events are about. **[This is the deep, intentional, and critical work that makes organizing possible. Will you chip in $10, or whatever you can spare, to keep it going?](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqswjENXoYacFGtlMLXh6NAeIGjw8YzSH_UAUmMq7WLV0krCNSeQgLJ3AAolc0INa2dK3v7kn_nd8KmGRkL-7mPPr7QcLgbrlNzH-xfzrS2bKbJXWzNZyA4olx0fsihulho0ONS65lRoYTletIsvdeK3uYnVf6Yr2_uexQHc6-tQK45Bt2xqCx5XnW5YgKzmmfdwoXa7bKQxKlfRGEmKK_D20VOPRgAPfCHcAsIT1SW8ym-MzuxifNgMQ6SkdNLcIMy-ogvptsG4xSSAgSjO5o99z2qrj-VDQm7xKqXCQRxrfpUbL14kGBNJAYpRfu2qXI-jQVj3XhGz1pIfc9Uj4IKApDjQygC2P3Nq9k34jiCtwjGKk8YGs7sr76WpKxAPj4kZTN5J8YBSG-wFsJfQzvbpdwMwVpkBU7Qs--z0w99l7jN8cNdudv0e8G1SPoO-LFvTTKWW5OjsxD5WA-0HWu0O4UhPbrSJ_YbZ8WbkySlQ6A/4ud/ZIrCPgtXTwi_uyM3-iG4hg/h0/h001.-DlGewqedOw74wSYE_5riGr_weUeX2SPAE4CJNwqEMo)** [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqswjENXoYacFGtlMLXh6NAeIGjw8YzSH_UAUmMq7WLV0krCNSeQgLJ3AAolc0INa2dK3v7kn_nd8KmGRkL-7mPPr7QcLgbrlNzH-xfzrS2bKaqc4Hg9EbTtYvErDXagWj_xKMnKEuiybiTDGA2vB26I97tUKHlqE18MYhSd3V0fuTVDAAyukYX227kNG0raWWAuumTXmDOB4gSp6nKYi_YhOBnyAJysWipchaBhe8GsWhEOMnyXvCVeYQPnmZ4xuGaj0tvGYQQClZVHQKhlu3RdeO-6rwJPSO4tTHR0gY_cuGwCpIG45H_q5Pafp1mNPu5JizSvPnarsPBg01t8W11Lri7MMJlDd9DYcI7-nRuMPuRc639jbnrlrJ1-i0WS9d8rXd9yIde6oVmNYX4L3Zki9CxkoUsYCoQ6_MzKuOs85R6uu2X9TqfFCSYEhzpEJdp7BfAdeYYHYdZBpmttvT6_/4ud/ZIrCPgtXTwi_uyM3-iG4hg/h1/h001.-EH-ZnNJTpc08xVcvwp4je5Luwpovn9810T82AsdjVA) Every organizer spent six weeks and 12 sessions in **Level Up: The Dream Lab** , United We Dream's leadership training series, where they learned how to tell their story, build a team, and plan an event from start to finish. United We Dream paired them with teammates in their region, coached them through every step, and made sure no one organized alone. Here's why it matters. Fear and isolation are a strategy. When families are being separated, and students are being priced out of college, it's easier to keep us divided so we can't see that millions of us are facing the same thing. When we come together, we remember we're not alone, and we get organized. That's how movements grow: not in one big moment, but in hundreds of small rooms where someone decided to show up. **[United We Dream is building a working-class movement one room at a time. clean_body: Here's the unglamorous work behind every new organizer. | | | Peter, Today, young organizers across the country do the work people often don’t see when it comes to organizing: building lasting relationships, trust, and community. From organizing a Know Your Rights session in Texas to a rock climbing day in Chicago and an art gathering in California, effective organizing cannot happen without community building. On the surface, these events might look simple. A room. Some snacks. A sign-in sheet. Here's what you don't see: the relationships being built in that room and beyond. Neighbors meeting neighbors. Classmates realizing they're facing the same fears. People on the same block learning they can count on each other. We can't organize people we don't know. Every action and every win starts with relationships in our communities, on our blocks, and in our schools. That's what these events are about. Every organizer spent six weeks and 12 sessions in Level Up: The Dream Lab , United We Dream's leadership training series, where they learned how to tell their story, build a team, and plan an event from start to finish. United We Dream paired them with teammates in their region, coached them through every step, and made sure no one organized alone. Here's why it matters. Fear and isolation are a strategy. When families are being separated, and students are being priced out of college, it's easier to keep us divided so we can't see that millions of us are facing the same thing. When we come together, we remember we're not alone, and we get organized. That's how movements grow: not in one big moment, but in hundreds of small rooms where someone decided to show up. **To:** Peter
**From:** Tiernan Donohue, Chief Campaigns Officer
**Date:** September 26, 2026
**Subject:** 38 Days Left — The Path to Taking Back Power
=====================================================
At the start of 2025, we promised that we would put women at the center of the fight to take back power in this country, and with 38 days left, EMILYs List has delivered on that promise.
**Mission Majority: A Strategic Initiative That Puts EMILYs List Women At the Center of the Path to Flip the U.S. House**
Back in early 2025 when EMILYs laid out the most aggressive target map for the House of any national organization, a lot of people said it was too ambitious. Today, because of our recruitment work and candidate services, close to a dozen of those races are rated as "Toss Ups" and we have 25 Majority Makers running in the districts that we can flip and will decide control of the U.S. House. From top-tier battlegrounds to emerging seats where strong candidates and grassroots energy have put previously safe GOP-held seats into play. EMILYs List is fully mobilized behind these key races.
**Flipping the U.S. Senate: Our Candidates Are the Strategy**
In the battle for the Senate majority, EMILYs List women have made seats previously thought to be tough territory highly competitive. Our candidates are proving to be the strongest messengers on the issues that will decide this election — lowering the cost of living, expanding access to quality healthcare, and taking on corruption. These races are going to be at the center of the fight to flip the Senate heading into November.
**State Power Plan: Our Plan To Take Back Governing Power in Nine Key States**
We've seen states serve as a critical check against the chaos and cruelty coming out of Washington. To counter Republicans' partisan gerrymandering, preserve our healthcare, and enact policies that make life easier for everyday Americans, we need to build Democratic governing power in critical states this November. That's why EMILYs List recruited, launched, and trained strong candidates running up and down the ballot in nine key states: Arizona, Georgia, Michigan, Minnesota, Nevada, New Mexico, North Carolina, Pennsylvania, and Wisconsin. These are states where we can break Republican governing trifectas, elect women governors for the first time, and take back power at the state level heading into the crucial 2028 election. Our staff across the country are digging in on the data and reporting on increasing potential powered by voter enthusiasm and a real desire to see change.
There are only 38 days left until Election Day. This is the window where investment translates most directly into votes — funding the final push of paid media and organizing programs that will decide these races on the margins. Make no mistake, these races will be close. That's why we are asking for your support at this critical moment.
