|
Peter,
Trump's administration cronies willing to do his dirty work for him have been bullying election officials in states across the country since the moment he returned to the White House.
As a result, Trump's actions--ordering the FBI to seize ballots, red state gerrymandering, and using ICE and DHS to try and build a fake voter database to prove "noncitizen and unlawful voters"--have dominated the news cycles for almost two years.
This has made it seem like MAGA got the upper hand in a lopsided battle between the full might of the federal government against county and state election clerks and secretaries of state.
Yet buried in the headlines are more than mere glimmers of hope--in some cases, the blueprint for defeating Trump's scheme to intimidate, bully, and cheat his way to victory this midterm is right there.
And the truth is this:
When MAGA election deniers are called out and pushed to show real proof, they fold like cheap tents.
---
| | [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001GY1wGv0aIAC4VTH7paqWDMwbdVMWQYTCaO4ByTe9nDBrt1b_s0TvQRGMLTRuPW1Qg6mmARqtTPvw00eUC3VvVstb8Erp5i85TW-PWDU_XKeKyTy9G2UdxbINqM6scwnQvP3j_ow435_FodCPqbbcNy0NiysV87-job904Or9UR3F1cIAVfvTCzq6V5DhFPKHb42O261eo7j8IAx-_6URRdPSSV6f08Qq7RZrHNgUpQ0=&c=Z7W23OASj7x-Ns0wNahXwfcXTjIi9pEYOaQif6CYv6V6lEJndA-tcw==&ch=OeaMdfSky9eFRDYxjYrqr_wkvKH6z6phQLDpNyNx42ias_ND4Wz8Jw==)
---
In Nevada, a state that voted for Trump in 2016 and again in 2024 and has a Republican governor, officials there investigated the Trump Admin's claims that over 15,900 voters were flagged in an "internal review" as likely unlawful or noncitizens.
They called them on their bullshit; demanded proof, received none; and then discovered they were straight up lying: the voters they had flagged as illegal were in fact citizens, valid voters that the Department of Homeland Security was trying to have purged from the voter rolls.
This is why it is so important to fight for every single state court judicial seat, every local election official, and every part of our system that can stand against MAGA's fascist agenda: they may be the very last line of defense against MAGA's attack on our democracy, but if we fight back, demand truth and accountability, and refuse to give in we will defeat Trump.

We are witnessing a new and dangerous red-green alliance: communists and Islamists, coming together and sweeping over the Democrat Party. They are united because they share the same enemies. My own father was imprisoned and tortured by dictators in Cuba. I know exactly where this road leads, and I will not watch it happen here. Look at who the left is elevating. And hear me clearly: Sharia law has no place in America, because it is fundamentally inconsistent with our Constitution. Derek,
I'm personally asking you to [**pitch in $7 to the DNC today**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-september-2026-gfr?amount=7&refcode=em_20260926_9408_fr&refcode2=9408_22930333_wa6er2&akid=9408%2E22930333%2Ewa6er2) — but first, I want to explain how this is a pivotal moment in Democrats’ fight to win back control of the U.S. Senate.
Some of the most important races in the entire country are happening in Alaska, North Carolina, Ohio, Michigan, Georgia, Iowa, and Maine.
Democrats didn’t jump into these races because they think it's going to be a walk in the park. They saw that working people everywhere are facing skyrocketing grocery prices, unaffordable healthcare, and a rigged economy built for billionaires, **and they decided to do something about it.**
Now, Republicans and their billionaire backers are pouring hundreds of millions of dollars into attack ads to defeat them. I’m no stranger to the special interests that fight to block our agenda. We’ve kept up the righteous fight for universal childcare, a wealth tax, Medicare for All, and affordable housing. And securing more allies in the House and Senate, and then taking back the White House in 2028, is **essential** to passing an agenda that’s dedicated to improving the lives of the people we serve.
That is why one of the most powerful actions you can take right now is to [**invest in the DNC, the only organization committed to electing Democrats at every single level of government.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-september-2026-gfr?amount=7&refcode=em_20260926_9408_fr&refcode2=9408_22930333_wa6er2&akid=9408%2E22930333%2Ewa6er2)
99.7% of the DNC’s donations come from grassroots supporters. We know you can't beat a corrupt system with candidates who are beholden to it. You need an opposition movement powered by people. That’s exactly what the DNC is building.
[**The number of donations matters far more than the size of your gift, because each contribution will send a powerful message that Americans are ready for a government that works for working people. In his career as a College Football Coach, Tommy started a long and successful career at the University of Miami, starting as a graduate assistant and rising to the Hurricanes' defensive coordinator. He led the Canes to three AP national championships and coached future Hall of Famers Ray Lewis and Warren Sapp, as well as Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson. In 1998, Coach Tuberville was announced as the next head coach for the Auburn Tigers. Tuberville's time at Auburn was a success by any measure, as the Tigers captured eight consecutive bowl appearances, including five New Year's Day bowl appearances, five SEC Western Division titles, one SEC Championship, and a 13-0 season in 2004, after which Coach Tuberville was once again named the AP's SEC Coach of the Year. For his efforts during the perfect 2004 season, Tuberville would be named Paul "Bear" Bryant Coach of the Year, Associated Press Coach of the Year, Walter Camp Coach of the Year, Sporting News Coach of the Year, and AFCA Coach of the Year, among others. In 2020, Coach Tuberville became Senator Tuberville, winning his election to represent all Alabamians in the United States Senate with the full support of President Trump. Since then, he's supported President Trump's America-First policies while fighting off the Radical Left. In his first term as Senator, Tommy was one of eight Republicans to vote against certifying the 2020 election, has been a strong pro-life advocate, and called out Democrats for being pro-crime. Now, Coach Tuberville is running for Governor so he can continue representing Alabamians and Americans in his homestate of Alabama. The Radical Left thinks they can flip Alabama blue and turn it into the California of the South. Can he count on your support? Trump's new filing shows 1,156 trades in a single month -- including $25 million exits from Microsoft and Amazon. The Pelosi and Greene scandals were the warm-up act.
For years, the story was Nancy Pelosi. Her husband's big-tech call options. The returns that embarrassed hedge funds. The retail "Pelosi tracker," the trading-ban bills nicknamed after her, the decade-long suspicion that she knew what the House would do before the House did.
Then Marjorie Taylor Greene bought the dip days before Trump's tariff pause, and cable news got its chyron: insider trading?
**Both were scandals. Both were, by volume, small.**
On Tuesday we got the real thing. The president's periodic disclosure lists 1,156 transactions in July alone -- roughly $79 million to $270 million in volume, by CNBC's analysis. The largest entries: sales of $5-25 million each of Microsoft and Amazon on July 20. That was the day the Magnificent 7 added $291 billion in market value -- his accounts sold into the pop, then bought back smaller stakes three days later. There were six-figure rounds in Nvidia, Palantir, CrowdStrike, Oracle, Costco, Intuit.
This is not a president with a brokerage account. This is a presidency with a trading desk.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/3b96cc12-ce96-464e-a007-3aad010bce25?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**What Microsoft and Amazon announced -- and when**
Ask what the companies did around the sales, and the timeline does the talking.
Microsoft, July 6: 4,800 layoffs -- 2.1% of its global workforce, its second straight year of mass cuts after 9,100 in 2025. Xbox hit. Commercial sales hit. Two weeks later, the president's accounts sold up to $25 million of Microsoft -- into a rally.
Amazon, the bad news bracketed the sale. In January, ~16,000 corporate jobs went, on top of 14,000 the fall before. On July 22 -- two days after the sale -- Amazon confirmed layoffs inside its artificial-general-intelligence unit, the teams building its Nova models. And in August, the agency that polices Amazon was Trump's own FTC, which sued the company over an alleged "secret ad surcharge scheme" -- while the presidential portfolio was actively trading the stock.
To be precise, no filing proves anyone sold on advance knowledge of those announcements. But that was never the point of the Pelosi outrage either. The point was that a public official's personal portfolio kept intersecting with the very events their office shaped. The point was appearance. That standard just got obliterated at scale.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/bdec3843-0a7b-4360-92e0-d9e33785e5f4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
** "Someone else manages it"**
Here's the part that should get more attention than it is.
When MTG's tariff-timing purchases drew probe calls, the answer was: a financial advisor handles it. When the Pelosi portfolio beat the S&P year after year, the answer was: Paul does it, Nancy doesn't own a share.
When Trump's 1,156-trade month surfaced -- alongside the 3,400 to 3,600 trades Warren counts from the first three months of 2026 -- the White House answer was the same sentence with different nouns: the portfolio is independently managed by third-party managers.
The defense that made Congress a scandal is now the White House talking point. And the "blind trust" convention that every modern president accepted -- Carter selling the peanut farm, Obama and Biden in index funds -- has been replaced by an actively traded portfolio holding Nvidia while the administration writes AI export policy, and Palantir while it holds federal contracts with Defense and ICE.
**The volume nobody 's matching**
I'll keep the comparison honest, because the numbers are the story.
Greene, 437 trades over two years -- about 17 a month, 429 buys and 8 sells. Her big moment was up to $315,000 deployed just before Trump's "great time to buy" post. That bought her House-floor confrontations and probe calls.
Pelosi, dozens of trades a year, executed by her husband, scrutinized like earnings calls.
Trump, 1,156 trades in one month -- more than two and a half times Greene's entire two-year output, roughly an order of magnitude beyond Pelosi's annual pace. And that's just July. The first-quarter filing counted thousands more.
His volume isn't just larger. It's a different category of thing.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/fc98677b-313e-407e-91ac-da9ee564bb9e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**The part that 's actually different**
Pelosi had one vote out of 435. Greene has one vote out of 435. Their trading raised the question: did they know something?
The president doesn't need to know something. He is the something.
He sets the tariffs that move the market. He directs the FTC that sued Amazon in August. He signs the AI chip rules that decide Nvidia's biggest market. He appointed the enforcers who would have to investigate him -- which is why Senator Warren's push for an insider-trading inquiry died on Treasury Secretary Bessent's dodge at a June hearing, and why Warren and Rep. Robert Garcia's demand that Trump name his money managers has gone precisely nowhere.
The STOCK Act doesn't cover the president. The federal conflict-of-interest statute contains an exemption carved out for exactly this office. Congress wrote a law named after the appearance of corruption; the presidency exempted itself from the need to.
**The kicker**
The Pelosi tracker was a scandal because a Speaker's husband seemed to anticipate legislation. The MTG fury was a scandal because a backbencher bought stocks before her ally's announcement moved the market. Both rightly appalled people. Both involved power that was adjacent to the trade.
This filing shows something the trackers never saw: a president, inside his own term, running a portfolio that traded his regulators' targets and the subjects of his own policy -- 1,156 times in a month -- while the explanation on file is the same "someone else manages it" that turned his congressional critics into symbols of corruption.
A hedge fund gets a manager. A presidency used to get a blind trust. This one got both -- and the president kept the returns.
The disclosure is legal. That's the scandal.

Trump's new filing shows 1,156 trades in a single month -- including $25 million exits from Microsoft and Amazon. The Pelosi and Greene scandals were the warm-up act.
For years, the story was Nancy Pelosi. Her husband's big-tech call options. The returns that embarrassed hedge funds. The retail "Pelosi tracker," the trading-ban bills nicknamed after her, the decade-long suspicion that she knew what the House would do before the House did.
Then Marjorie Taylor Greene bought the dip days before Trump's tariff pause, and cable news got its chyron: insider trading?
**Both were scandals. Both were, by volume, small.**
On Tuesday we got the real thing. The president's periodic disclosure lists 1,156 transactions in July alone -- roughly $79 million to $270 million in volume, by CNBC's analysis. The largest entries: sales of $5-25 million each of Microsoft and Amazon on July 20. That was the day the Magnificent 7 added $291 billion in market value -- his accounts sold into the pop, then bought back smaller stakes three days later. There were six-figure rounds in Nvidia, Palantir, CrowdStrike, Oracle, Costco, Intuit...

Capital Rotation -- September 25, 2026

The Yield Story Didn't Need a Headline This Time. That's the Point.

Oil rose despite a concrete Iran peace proposal. Yields hit fresh multi-decade highs for the third straight session, on no single catalyst -- the most consistent trend this month, and the one investors may be underweighting.

|
---

| | What Moved
---|---

**Verified fact:** Thursday's equity session was essentially flat -- S&P 500 -0.07%, Nasdaq -0.06%, Dow -0.32% -- while WTI crude rose 1.04% to $93.12 and Brent rose 1.53% to $104.70. The 10-year Treasury yield hit 5.192%, its highest since 2007, and the 30-year yield reached 5.476%, its highest since 2004.

| | Rotation Signal 01 -- Oil Rose Despite, Not Because of, Thursday's Diplomatic News
---|---

**Our interpretation:** Iran's concrete seven-day Hormuz proposal would, on its face, argue for lower oil prices on rising odds of resolution. That oil rose instead suggests markets are weighting Rubio's skepticism ("not a major breakthrough") and the unresolved sequencing dispute more heavily than the proposal's existence -- a more cautious read than the market's reaction to news over the past two weeks.

| | Rotation Signal 02 -- The Yield Story Is Now the Single Most Consistent Trend This Month
---|---

**Verified fact:** Thursday marked the third consecutive session of fresh multi-decade highs across the yield curve, with the 30-year now at its highest level since 2004. **Our interpretation:** across three sessions this week, equities have moved on diplomatic and corporate-specific news (Meta's AI announcement, oil headlines), while Treasury yields have climbed steadily regardless of the day's other news -- the most durable, singular trend this newsletter has identified all month, and arguably more consequential for broad portfolio positioning than any single day's Iran or China headline.

| | Rotation Signal 03 -- A Trade Truce Extension Removes Near-Term Tail Risk Without Resolving the Setup
---|---

**Current classification: PRESSURE deferred, not resolved, on both the China and Iran tracks; CONFIRMATION of a structural yield repricing.** Semiconductor and rare-earth-exposed names likely got a genuine, if temporary, reprieve from the January 10 extension; energy-sensitive positioning got a more ambiguous signal, given oil rose despite ostensibly positive Iran news.

| | What to Watch This Week
---|---

Whether the 10- and 30-year yields continue climbing into next week absent any new catalyst, which would further confirm this as a structural, not headline-driven, move; and how markets ultimately price Iran's Hormuz proposal once Washington's formal response, if any, becomes public.

Yields hit fresh multi-decade highs for the third straight session, on no single catalyst -- the most consistent trend this month, and the one investors may be underweighting. | | | What Moved ---|--- Verified fact: Thursday's equity session was essentially flat -- S&P 500 -0.07%, Nasdaq -0.06%, Dow -0.32% -- while WTI crude rose 1.04% to $93.12 and Brent rose 1.53% to $104.70. The 10-year Treasury yield hit 5.192%, its highest since 2007, and the 30-year yield reached 5.476%, its highest since 2004. | | Rotation Signal 01 -- Oil Rose Despite, Not Because of, Thursday's Diplomatic News ---|--- Our interpretation: Iran's concrete seven-day Hormuz proposal would, on its face, argue for lower oil prices on rising odds of resolution. That oil rose instead suggests markets are weighting Rubio's skepticism ("not a major breakthrough") and the unresolved sequencing dispute more heavily than the proposal's existence -- a more cautious read than the market's reaction to news over the past two weeks. | | Rotation Signal 02 -- The Yield Story Is Now the Single Most Consistent Trend This Month ---|--- Verified fact: Thursday marked the third consecutive session of fresh multi-decade highs across the yield curve, with the 30-year now at its highest level since 2004. **[I'm not exaggerating when I say that today needs to be our biggest grassroots fundraising day ever. 2. Senate Republicans put out a cry for help a few weeks ago asking outside spenders to swoop in and bail out Jon Husted. Elon Musk, Peter Thiel, and Donald Trump have already sent in reinforcements and that now means Republicans are spending more in Ohio than anywhere else in the country.

3. **We're doing something right.** Look, the Senate map is ripe with opportunities for Democrats to flip seats, and Republicans are training their eye on Ohio. That is not a coincidence. That is not a mistake. The GOP is the most worried about the campaign Sherrod is running – and that's why they're doing everything they can to put up roadblocks.

**I won't pretend that this spending is nothing to worry about. It has the potential to crush us.** We won’t be able to match their spending 1:1, but we have to be able to stay competitive. If we can mount a strong response, Sherrod will be able to keep his narrow lead in the polls and swing back at Republican attacks.
**[I'm authorizing a $1 million emergency response fund to help us fend off the attacks. body:

Peter, we’re 37 days and a wake-up from Election Day.
All I have to say to you right now is this: **Thank you for being a part of this incredible team.**
[](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260926-2.Zk1lXx&refcode=em-20260926-2&t=2&akid=1995%2E1086043%2EZwe0AS)
It’s thanks to the dedication of our volunteers that Team Moore is able to show up and show out, from events like the Tawes Crab and Clam Bake on the Eastern Shore this week to canvassing shifts and phone banks nearly every day.
It’s thanks to the generosity of our grassroots donors that we’re building up our operation and getting our message out to Marylanders on TV and online.
**And it’s thanks to the determination of each and every one of you that we’re going to make sure we Leave No One Behind.**
Together, we’ll continue this mission for another term -- I know it. **[If you’re ready to power that work with donation today, I would appreciate it.](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260926-2.Zk1lXx&refcode=em-20260926-2&t=3&akid=1995%2E1086043%2EZwe0AS)** 🙏🏽

You might say I’m biased – Midwestern roots run deep when it comes to loyalty and your sense of what matters. But what I admire most about Sherrod isn’t just where he’s from. It’s what guides him. He’s built his life in public service around a simple, powerful idea: the Dignity of Work. He believes that everyone – no matter their background, their ZIP code, or their job title – deserves respect, security, and a fair shot. He insists that if you put in an honest day’s work, you ought to be able to build a stable life and look to the future with confidence.
Our politics should honor the people who keep our communities running, not overlook them.
Sherrod has spent his career doing just that: showing up in communities others ignore, telling the truth even when it’s uncomfortable, and standing with working people even when it means taking on entrenched power.
His record reflects that commitment. He’s fought to protect pensions so retirees can count on what they earned. He’s taken on pharmaceutical companies to lower prescription drug costs. He’s stood up to corporations that put profit ahead of people. Again and again, he’s stood up to powerful interests in the name of working families, often when it wasn’t easy.
There’s also a bigger picture here. There is no path to building a Senate that delivers for working families without flipping this seat. No strategy for moving our country forward that doesn’t run through Ohio. The direction of our politics in the years ahead will depend, in no small part, on whether Sherrod Brown continues to serve.
Bottom line: Ohio won’t find a stronger champion for working people.

*By subscribing to my e-mail updates, you are authorizing me to send regular e-mail updates from my office to your e-mail account.
#
# **Funding Youth Programs That Are Changing Lives**

[Senator Hughes and Senator Sharif Street](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100172461.172449.270&gen=1&mailing_linkid=18411) joined [Level Up Philly](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100172461.172449.270&gen=1&mailing_linkid=18412) Founder, Pastor Aaron Campbell, staff, and over 600 Level Up Philly students to celebrate $500,000 in new state funding for the organization, from the Pennsylvania Department of Education.

At Level Up Philly, students have access to a home cooked meal, a math lab, a STEM lab, a room where [viral dance battles](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100172461.172449.270&gen=1&mailing_linkid=18413) take place, and most importantly, leaders and mentors who make students feel seen, welcome, and safe.

* * *
"It's important these students understand how special this program is and how special they are. No other program in the Commonwealth is structured like Level Up. No other youth program in Pennsylvania is serving students from 151 schools, and we want even more students to come and benefit from this space and program."
- Senator Hughes
* * *

According to the [Center for American Progress](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100172461.172449.270&gen=1&mailing_linkid=18414), Community Violence Intervention programs, like Level Up Philly, have nationally reduced shootings by as much as 60% and reduced arrests for violent crimes by more than 70%. The work of Level Up Philly and other area intervention initiatives that give young people new opportunities and community are a key factor in Philadelphia's declining violence metrics, with the city seeing a 40% decline in homicides in the past year.
Senator Hughes is committed to continuing to bring funding to our district to help bring change at the community and local level.

"We are proud of these young people, and we want them to continue to lift themselves up with the help of Level Up Philly."
- Senator Hughes

name: OnePA Team
subject: Hands off our vote
body:
Trump is already trying to build the case to throw out the 2026 count in majority-Black cities and districts. | |
---
Peter, **In February, Donald Trump singled out Philadelphia, Detroit, and Atlanta from the Oval Office, called their elections “horrible corruption,” and said federal agents should count the votes.** These cities are home to large Black communities whose ballots shape statewide races, and Trump is naming them now to try to convince voters that their November 3 results should not count. **Right now his Justice Department is suing states, including Pennsylvania, for their voter rolls. He is still pushing the voter-suppression**** _SAVE America Act_****, which would force eligible Americans to produce a passport or birth certificate just to register.** His administration tried to put their hand-picked head of the Postal Service in charge of which mail ballots get delivered this fall. In January, the FBI seized ballots from Fulton County, the majority-Black heart of metro Atlanta. Courts have blocked pieces of this -- but the administration has not stopped looking for ways to sabotage our elections. Trump is deeply unpopular. The GOP approval ratings continue to fall. They know they can’t win fairly. **Fortune 500 CEOs run companies that employ millions of people in those same cities and districts. They write the political checks. They buy the ads. They get the White House and the Senate on the phone.** After 2020, too many of them waited while voters in majority-Black cities and districts were told their ballots were the problem. **Silence from that kind of power is permission.** **They need to take the Hands Off Our Vote pledge in public.** Demand that they speak out now, publicly opposing election interference and sabotage, standing for democracy and insisting every eligible vote must be counted. Demand that they commit to speak out _after_ Election Day as well, saying the results must be certified, elected officials must be seated, and the will of the people must be respected and obeyed. [**Tell Fortune 500 CEOs to take the Hands Off Our Vote pledge and stand by the certified vote.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm3-Nh01vKiAbzO_nA50wsi1YT04GnBRWacwecwWAbZjSnH0RcOnaLdoZfvJtVHQZzRqEMnB3P8fuKni-bi81H9iaP6EgdMrqpcVU3TjDT4qbSLGMMtaE-ppoKC04xoBtrft5HwGa6YdCyeIjYh8luHuqu7zvqCODelUNN8XjyTzWRkyxqe9ay85e4PXHK-eMIvostlOfmUTvlBTovj_fdcV71jXgTjl_G9I0WfqPf_HoZBHy9b0afQvzhhkRPQ-AQaWehwosR0HjmrRS2NDKsEIBigtLvfpH6RhOrrYgkjEnwee4KVDCW3jpdDVpY6SWQaT4AU2iGjcsAljbjQ3eWTzQbnvXmr_IwSxOJp6SIKMqKx1JbJUYDvxsoH9DyVsl4lJLrJq0tt6a6BPmH9uFo7fowrZtU0T3YjTKAUfN66zqGMca7weaNayHiHWFPj0I5uY/4ud/y5Aji8CRRlmbhPedDau7DA/h0/h001.cR4mjS3MaphSx2IkGSBK5ddY61HYxkeGsRX--Y3DacY) | | [SIGN & SEND](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm3-Nh01vKiAbzO_nA50wsi1YT04GnBRWacwecwWAbZjSnH0RcOnaLdoZfvJtVHQZzRqEMnB3P8fuKni-bi81H9iaP6EgdMrqpcVU3TjDT4qbSLGMMtaE-ppoKC04xoBtrft5HwGa6YdCyeIjYh8luHuqu7zvqCODelUNN8XjyTzWRkyxqe9ay85e4PXHK-eMIvostlOfmUTvlBTovj_fdcV71jXgTjl_G9I0WfqPf_HoZLZsRDw-94CgmnnHFpv_imiZ68_F0ioDjPFwuXGStg-v-R4hD1yqdxMgHx73Vqnz9KBNmsLCjtPjoQIBLYCAs0vJLfBvg7IFm8gJwEHK2aFkYGWQl_yfO6dKkcJD1AJ7uOMBTPmrW299FmiBNSnwzJ8gSUyLobpI2oO516mhMOPo4xPrfanMT-61uAbbK1I9TWxAgv1LWyGvg9Rb5r3GzH8/4ud/y5Aji8CRRlmbhPedDau7DA/h1/h001.LWkkgq-mCtTYFrRyTlET5ynIqRdlTTznfodV50LSibs)

**The MAGA agenda is more unpopular every day. In order to stay in power, Trump and his party will have to cheat. They are trying to keep eligible voters from the ballot, and trying to build the case to throw out the count in majority-Black cities and districts.** That is how they try to declare themselves the winners before our communities have finished speaking.
A Fortune 500 CEO who stays quiet is telling every worker on the payroll, every customer, and everyone in the communities they reside that the company doesn’t care about civil rights, democracy, or what kind of government we live under -- even if it's authoritarian. clean_body: Trump is already trying to build the case to throw out the 2026 count in majority-Black cities and districts. | | Peter, In February, Donald Trump singled out Philadelphia, Detroit, and Atlanta from the Oval Office, called their elections “horrible corruption,” and said federal agents should count the votes. These cities are home to large Black communities whose ballots shape statewide races, and Trump is naming them now to try to convince voters that their November 3 results should not count. Right now his Justice Department is suing states, including Pennsylvania, for their voter rolls. He is still pushing the voter-suppression SAVE America Act, which would force eligible Americans to produce a passport or birth certificate just to register. His administration tried to put their hand-picked head of the Postal Service in charge of which mail ballots get delivered this fall. In January, the FBI seized ballots from Fulton County, the majority-Black heart of metro Atlanta. Courts have blocked pieces of this -- but the administration has not stopped looking for ways to sabotage our elections. Trump is deeply unpopular. The GOP approval ratings continue to fall. They know they can’t win fairly. Fortune 500 CEOs run companies that employ millions of people in those same cities and districts. They write the political checks. They buy the ads. They get the White House and the Senate on the phone. After 2020, too many of them waited while voters in majority-Black cities and districts were told their ballots were the problem. Silence from that kind of power is permission. They need to take the Hands Off Our Vote pledge in public. Demand that they speak out now, publicly opposing election interference and sabotage, standing for democracy and insisting every eligible vote must be counted. Demand that they commit to speak out after Election Day as well, saying the results must be certified, elected officials must be seated, and the will of the people must be respected and obeyed. | | The MAGA agenda is more unpopular every day. In order to stay in power, Trump and his party will have to cheat. They are trying to keep eligible voters from the ballot, and trying to build the case to throw out the count in majority-Black cities and districts. That is how they try to declare themselves the winners before our communities have finished speaking. A Fortune 500 CEO who stays quiet is telling every worker on the payroll, every customer, and everyone in the communities they reside that the company doesn’t care about civil rights, democracy, or what kind of government we live under -- even if it's authoritarian. These companies have the reach and can have a real impact on what happens in November. We need them to stand against election sabotage, to stand for democracy, now, and when the polls close. body:
[](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260926_3.iEcDcK&refcode=em20260926-3&t=1&akid=9167%2E582294%2E4bmXtG)
I’m not running for reelection.
That’s why New Hampshire’s Senate seat is open this year.
Open seats are uniquely vulnerable in politics. There’s no incumbent to fall back on. It’s a fresh matchup, and both candidates running have to make the case for themselves from scratch. Republicans see that opening, which is why they’re pouring more than $50 million into this race. **[If you’re ready to fight back, chip in $5 to Chris Pappas’s campaign right now.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260926_3.iEcDcK&refcode=em20260926-3&t=2&akid=9167%2E582294%2E4bmXtG)**
Let’s be clear about who all that outside money is backing. John Sununu is not a new face in New Hampshire politics. He served in the House and then the Senate until I beat him in 2008. Now he wants his old job back – same famous last name, rich after three decades riding the revolving door, and wanting to reclaim the mantle of power.

| | | Hi team, it's Chris Pappas. **It’s official: I am the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate here in New Hampshire.**

I’m so grateful to every Granite Stater who put their trust in me and helped build this campaign together.

Growing up in Manchester and working alongside my family at our restaurant, I learned that you don’t get ahead just by making promises. You have to be accountable. You listen to people, work hard, and deliver.

That’s the same approach I’ve brought to Congress, and it’s why I’m running for the Senate.

I’m running to make New Hampshire more affordable for working families; protect Social Security, Medicare, and Medicaid; safeguard reproductive freedom; and stand up for the small businesses that are the backbone of our communities.

And now our general election fight against John Sununu officially begins.

Political experts just changed this race to a Toss-up, FNAME. The fact is: New Hampshire is a fiercely independent state, and this election could go either way. The country is watching, and the outcome here in New Hampshire will determine control of the U.S. Senate and what the next two years look like for millions of families across the country.

**[We are running a grassroots-powered campaign fueled by people like you. We need all hands on deck in order to keep New Hampshire blue and flip the Senate. It’s official: I am the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate here in New Hampshire. I’m so grateful to every Granite Stater who put their trust in me and helped build this campaign together. Growing up in Manchester and working alongside my family at our restaurant, I learned that you don’t get ahead just by making promises. You have to be accountable. You listen to people, work hard, and deliver. That’s the same approach I’ve brought to Congress, and it’s why I’m running for the Senate. I’m running to make New Hampshire more affordable for working families; protect Social Security, Medicare, and Medicaid; safeguard reproductive freedom; and stand up for the small businesses that are the backbone of our communities. And now our general election fight against John Sununu officially begins. Political experts just changed this race to a Toss-up, FNAME. The country is watching, and the outcome here in New Hampshire will determine control of the U.S. Senate and what the next two years look like for millions of families across the country. = = | | | John Sununu has spent his career putting Washington and corporate special interests ahead of Granite Staters. While he was in Congress, he voted to give tax breaks to Big Pharma and Big Oil, and now he’s profiting off of investments in those same industries. As we speak, national Republicans and dark-money groups are spending millions to put him back in the Senate because they know he’ll do the bidding of Trump and corporate interests, not look out for the people of New Hampshire. This race is a toss-up, so we need to join together right now and stay focused over the next eight weeks. = = When you love New Hampshire, you don’t just talk about what makes this state special. Fellow Conservative: Texas is about to decide the fate of the Senate majority — and if we lose it, we won't just lose a seat. We'll hand Democrats their first statewide win in Texas since 1994, and the earthquake will be felt by Americans across the country. First, let's be clear about how we got here. The Republican establishment in DC spent over $150 million — the most expensive Senate primary in American history — trying to stop Ken Paxton from becoming the nominee. _They lost._ Paxton defeated Sen. John Cornyn by nearly 30 points. But the damage was done, and now Democrat James Talarico is within striking distance of flipping the seat. You'd think Cornyn would be all-in to stop him from turning Texas blue. Nope. Instead, he's trashing Paxton as lazy and a poor campaigner, while telling reporters the party shouldn't spend another dime on his race because of limited resources. That's rich. **Even worse, Cornyn is working with former President George W. Bush to pull money out of Texas to fund moderate Senate candidates in other states — many of whom are far bigger underdogs than Paxton.** With friends like these, who needs enemies?

Ken Paxton has spent over a decade as Texas Attorney General doing what the GOP establishment only talks about. He sued the Biden administration more than any other AG in the country — on the border, on illegal mandates, on federal overreach — and won. While career politicians in Washington cut deals, Paxton has been on the front lines of the fight against the open-borders agenda. President Trump didn't endorse him as an afterthought — he called Paxton a "true MAGA warrior" because Paxton has earned it. That's exactly why the establishment tried to kill his campaign before it started and why they're throwing a temper tantrum now. clean_body: The RINOs in Texas are still throwing a fit over losing to Ken Paxton. | | | | | Fellow Conservative: Texas is about to decide the fate of the Senate majority — and if we lose it, we won't just lose a seat. We'll hand Democrats their first statewide win in Texas since 1994, and the earthquake will be felt by Americans across the country. First, let's be clear about how we got here. The Republican establishment in DC spent over $150 million — the most expensive Senate primary in American history — trying to stop Ken Paxton from becoming the nominee. They lost. Paxton defeated Sen. John Cornyn by nearly 30 points. But the damage was done, and now Democrat James Talarico is within striking distance of flipping the seat. You'd think Cornyn would be all-in to stop him from turning Texas blue. Nope. Instead, he's trashing Paxton as lazy and a poor campaigner, while telling reporters the party shouldn't spend another dime on his race because of limited resources. That's rich. Even worse, Cornyn is working with former President George W. Bush to pull money out of Texas to fund moderate Senate candidates in other states — many of whom are far bigger underdogs than Paxton. With friends like these, who needs enemies? Ken Paxton has spent over a decade as Texas Attorney General doing what the GOP establishment only talks about. He sued the Biden administration more than any other AG in the country — on the border, on illegal mandates, on federal overreach — and won. While career politicians in Washington cut deals, Paxton has been on the front lines of the fight against the open-borders agenda. President Trump didn't endorse him as an afterthought — he called Paxton a "true MAGA warrior" because Paxton has earned it. That's exactly why the establishment tried to kill his campaign before it started and why they're throwing a temper tantrum now. A real fighter in the Senate threatens the comfortable do-nothing environment they've built in DC. They'd rather have an empty suit who plays along with their empty promises and endless excuses than a conservative who delivers. Make no mistake: John Cornyn and the GOP establishment are working against Paxton because they want Texas to lose. They need it to lose, so they can point at the wreckage and say, "See? Only RINOs can win." It's a self-fulfilling prophecy. They know the game. Give conservative voters a choice between a Democrat and a RINO, and we'll hold our nose and vote RINO. But give us a choice between a Democrat and a real conservative, and the establishment would rather watch us lose than let us win on our own terms. It was never about winning a majority; it was about maintaining their control over the party. Senate Conservatives Fund exists for exactly this fight — to back conservative candidates in the races the party committees have already written off, when the committees would rather protect their own than protect the country. You can donate to SCF to support our independent efforts to elect Ken Paxton, and you can contribute directly to his campaign. It's the best way to help conservatives win in Texas. We are running out of time, so please take action before it's too late. to help Ken Paxton finish this fight — and send the establishment a message they won't forget: their days of picking our nominees for us are over. The future of the Republican Party belongs to conservatives, and we're sending John Cornyn's replacement to Washington. body:
| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/140041147/649328327/-49673432?refcode=em-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDM1MzYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNzA0NDdmNTItZmFiOS1mMTExLWE2YTktMDAwZDNhNTZkMmY3IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=8vLUCCemLJ_WwJS3wce50tOJd57Qj9CpvVr1Zfg4YcA=) Friend, **Escalating prices are a choice that the Trump administration made.** It started with an unauthorized war of choice that raised gas and energy prices. And instead of throwing money back to workers to help with the costs of gas, groceries, or even healthcare, the administration is now covering it up by telling the American people to change their habits and drive less -- because apparently nothing bad is ever Trump’s fault. Instead of making excuses, House Democrats are hard at work on legislation to make your life, and commute, more affordable. And in the short- and long-term, we can create even greater relief with a Democratic majority that **ends the President’s war of choice in Iran, puts a stop to unnecessary tariffs, and cuts red tape** so we can deliver on programs creating more affordable housing, prescription drugs, and more. name: Peggy Flanagan (via DNC HQ)
subject: A Folgers coffee can
body:
I didn’t think we would win
---
Derek, When I first ran for the Minneapolis School Board, I didn’t think we would win. I thought we would stand up for our community and share important concerns. But I never imagined how many of my neighbors shared those concerns. While I was running, I met an old woman at a public housing complex for urban native communities. She was selling frybread – and had a little Folgers coffee can where everyone was putting in $5. After we spoke, she took $5 out, put it in my hand, and wrapped her finger around it. She told me: “My girl, we’re so proud of you.” **That $5 meant more to me than a giant check from someone I knew could afford it.** I’m running for Senate to give back to the communities that have given me so much. I want to be the voice for Minnesota families in Washington. And folks know it. This is a grassroots campaign, powered by normal Minnesota families chipping in $5 or $10 at a time. Since our launch, our average contribution has been just $25. Some people give more, some people give less. But I am honored and humbled by every donation. clean_body: I didn’t think we would win Derek, When I first ran for the Minneapolis School Board, I didn’t think we would win. I thought we would stand up for our community and share important concerns. But I never imagined how many of my neighbors shared those concerns. While I was running, I met an old woman at a public housing complex for urban native communities. She was selling frybread – and had a little Folgers coffee can where everyone was putting in $5. After we spoke, she took $5 out, put it in my hand, and wrapped her finger around it. She told me: “My girl, we’re so proud of you.” That $5 meant more to me than a giant check from someone I knew could afford it. I’m running for Senate to give back to the communities that have given me so much. I want to be the voice for Minnesota families in Washington. And folks know it. This is a grassroots campaign, powered by normal Minnesota families chipping in $5 or $10 at a time. Since our launch, our average contribution has been just $25. I've spent over a decade of my life registering new Republican voters -- too many to count -- because I've learned one unshakable truth: nothing wins elections like having a bigger pool of voters than the Democrats. Not a mailer. Not a TV ad nobody watches. Not a "we'll match your gift" gimmick some consultant cooked up to squeeze one more dollar out of you. Just a voter registration activist with a clipboard and the determination to make sure every single Republican they meet is registered to vote and casts a ballot. With less than 50 days until Election Day, my organization Early Vote Action is staffing up in the swing states and critical races that will decide control of Congress. Just this week I'm deploying at least nine more voter registration staffers across four of the most competitive House districts in the country. In most states, the lieutenant governor is a largely ceremonial position. **In Texas,****that couldn’t be further from the truth. ** **The Texas Lt. Governor controls** the entire Texas Senate — setting the agenda, appointing committee chairs, deciding which bills live and which ones die. _It is one of the most powerful positions in state government in America._ Dan Patrick has held it for over a decade, and he has used every bit of that power:
* **_To push book bans and keep parents and educators fighting culture wars instead of fixing underfunded schools.

_**
* **_To drain money from public schools by forcing through the billion-dollar voucher scheme.

_**
* **_To hand out BILLIONS in taxpayer incentives to AI data center companies...the same companies whose investors have poured millions into his campaign._**

Before Ken Paxton’s impeachment trial began, a pro-Paxton political group gave Dan Patrick $1 million and loaned it another $2 million. Patrick presided over the trial, and lo and behold! Paxton was acquitted. **This is the system of corruption that has become the norm under Dan Patrick.** When I sat down with Velshi last night, I made the case that what happens in the Texas Lt. Governor's office doesn't stay in Texas. Water policy, school funding, energy infrastructure, reproductive rights — these are decided by whoever controls the Texas Senate calendar. And the decisions we make impact the whole nation. I'm running to change the trajectory of our state, and our country. To put the power back in the hands of the people. And to fight for every Texan.
For Texas, Rep. Vikki Goodwin

subject: “What the hell is going on in America?”

body:
I know a lot of you are watching the news and feeling anxious about what is happening in this country.

I know a lot of you are watching the news and feeling anxious about what is happening in this country.
I get it.
Republicans have total control of the White House, Congress and the courts and have used that power to take away people's health care to give tax cuts for the richest people in the country. They are starting and supporting tariffs and wars that drive prices up and America's standing in the world declines.
Meanwhile, Donald Trump is still trying to rig the next election as the first votes are being cast.
The good news is, we have a chance to do something about it.
And we must.
Because everything is on the line and the only way forward is for Democrats to organize and mobilize until the final polls close on Election Day.
This is a moment that reminds me of Bobby Kennedy's eulogy of his brother, President John F. Kennedy at the Democratic Convention.
He said that JFK would have never been able to accomplish any of what he had without the support of all of you — the Democratic Party. He said that when we’re in it together, we can accomplish a great deal.
That is the approach we have to take, because Donald Trump is capable of a-n-y-t-h-i-n-g.
I often get asked by world leaders, What the hell is going on in America?
**[Here's my answer and what we're doing about it. Please watch.](https://act.gavinnewsom.com/go/11796?t=1&akid=3047%2E4767699%2ECOk3H5)**
[](https://act.gavinnewsom.com/go/11796?t=2&akid=3047%2E4767699%2ECOk3H5)
I'm doing all I can to help elect Democrats everywhere this November. I know you're doing the same.
Gavin Newsom
* * *

🇺🇸 🇺🇸 **To my fellow Democrats — Please do not click away.** 🙏 🙏
I am often asked about 2028 ... and everytime it happens I respond that there is no free and fair election in 2028 unless Democrats take back the House in 2026.
One of those candidates we need to win if there's going to be a wave is Chris Jones in Arkansas. He can win this race - he can flip this seat - but he needs the resources to get it done.
So I am asking you to please rush a contribution to Chris Jones' campaign before the final quarterly FEC deadline ends in a few days. I'm hoping we can send his a HUGE number of surprise donations to help him reach the voters needs to win.
[**If taking back the House is important to you, please rush a donation to Chris Jones for Congress in Arkansas. These are the kinds of races we need to fund if we're going to flip the House in November.**](https://act.gavinnewsom.com/go/11797?source=em260927&t=3&akid=3047%2E4767699%2ECOk3H5)
